Brisk but excellent food in a lovely location.

I enjoyed two excellent dinners here with my family while staying across the road at the Park Hyatt. The food really is very well done, and the menu is varied enough that a repeat visit was a joy not a trial. The only negative point - if at all - is that service is quick, so you can't have a 'languid' meal. The four of us were in and out in an hour both times, but as we were with teenage boys, that wasn't a problem - but maybe you'd not come here for a romantic two-some! But a lovely location and great food.

Fantastic!! , if you want a proper Omakase experience Yuzu is it, as a Londoner married to a Vietnamese lady, and a couple that enjoys great dining in HCM Yuzu ticks every box , 18 customers sat around the cooking station, one waiter (Ming) one chef (Anh) looked after myself, my wife and 1 single diner, Ming spoke perfect English explaining wine/sake list and at the end of the dinner the Japanese whiskeys, we chose a great red , then Ming gave us samples to try of sparkling sake which we were toasting with him, If you love sashimi and Maki then this is the experience for you , gold leaf by the tree full , dry ice every where , 14 food bites of absolute perfection, this is a honest review of a great night of quality dining, well done the Yuzu team , we will definitely be back
Food was good but not worth the price tag; customer service was bad overall

The other day, I enjoyed dinner at Yuzu Omakase in Ho Chi Minh City. Each dish that makes use of seasonal ingredients is beautiful and has a delicate taste that spreads in your mouth. The craftsmen's attentive commentary and hospitality allowed us to spend a luxurious time in a cozy space until the end. The volume of the course is also moderate and it is a very satisfying 5 stars!

Thank you very much for your kind words and for dining with us at Yuzu Omakase Ho Chi Minh City. We’re truly delighted to hear that you enjoyed the seasonal dishes, the atmosphere, and our team's hospitality. Your satisfaction means a lot to us, and we look forward to welcoming you back for another special experience soon.

Dinner at Yuzu gave me a real sense of craftsmanship. From the first appetizer to the final dessert, every dish is full of surprises, with heart and love in the details. The interaction with the chef, in particular, made me feel the charm of omakase - the perfect combination of trust and expectation. It's a satisfying and heartwarming dining experience that's worth revisiting.
Thank you so much for your kind words. We're glad you enjoyed the omakase experience and truly appreciate your support. Looking forward to welcoming you again ssoonsoon
Sweet memories with your loved one at Yuzu Omakase

It was really nice to be here with your other half to celebrate the special day! The ingredients are fresh and delicious, especially sea urchins and oxen, and the entrance melts. Quiet and tasteful environment ideal for dates or anniversaries. The staff were attentive and courteous and the overall experience was perfect. It's a wonderful memory and will definitely be back again!

Thank you so much for choosing Yuzu Omakase to celebrate your special day with your loved one. We're truly happy to hear that you had a memorable experience and enjoyed both the food and the atmosphere. Your kind words about our uni and wagyu mean a lot to us. We look forward to welcoming you back for more unforgettable moments together.

Yuz Omakase - Ho Chi Minh City:
 • Quality of food: Materials imported from Japan, fresh and beautifully presented and taste excellent.
 • Space: Luxurious and cozy Japanese style.
 • Service: Professional and friendly chefs carefully explain the cuisine.
 • Price: From 1.2 million to 10 million, depending on the quality.

👉 Suitable for experiencing advanced Japanese cuisine.

Thank you for the thoughtful review and clear breakdown! We're so pleased to hear that you enjoyed the quality of our ingredients, ambiance, and service. We look forward to welcoming you back for another refined omakase experience.

Tried the Journey menu at Yuzu and had a memorable experience. The counter setup lets you watch the chefs in action—great energy and attention to detail.

Standouts included toro, uni, and a sushi course wrapped in gold leaf. The truffle dish added a fun, unexpected twist. While some dishes were more subtle than others, the progression felt well thought-out and enjoyable.

Plan for a longer meal—it’s over 20 courses—so don’t rush. Ideal for a special occasion or if you’re curious about premium ingredients in an omakase format.

Thank you for sharing your experience with us! We're glad you enjoyed The Journey and appreciated the creativity and flow of the course. It means a lot to know the details stood out to you—especially the toro, uni, and our gold leaf sushi. We look forward to welcoming you again for another special evening at Yuzu.
The best experience when coming to Vietnam

I had a very interesting experience here. The food was extremely delicious and the show was amazing. You can talk to the chef to find out more about the source of the food. The service was very good. The wine was also very good and for the first time I had a wine that suited my taste. The staff are very attentive and always happy to help when I need help.

Thank you so much for your warm words! We're truly happy to hear that your time at Yuzu was a highlight of your trip to Vietnam. It's our pleasure to share not only delicious food and drinks, but also meaningful connections. We hope to welcome you back again soonsoon!

I have experienced the Omakase course at Yuzu Omakase in Ho Chi Minh City. The cuisine was prepared as sophisticated as a work of art, the visual was beautiful and the ingredients were very fresh. The taste was excellent and the service was very friendly and professional. However, the space is somewhat narrow, so it can be a bit responsive for several people to visit together. Recommended for those who want a special meal in a luxurious and private atmosphere.

Thank you for your thoughtful review. We're glad you enjoyed the quality, taste, and service of our omakase experience. We appreciate your feedback on the space and will keep it in mind. Looking forward to welcoming you back for another special evening at Yuzu.

Each course is well-prepared, with a thoughtful presentation and attention to detail. The chef introduces the dishes, providing insight into the ingredients and techniques used. The atmosphere is calm and intimate, making it a good place for a relaxed dining experience.

Overall, it’s a well-executed omakase with a creative touch. A good option for those who enjoy refined flavors with the freshness of fish and meat

Dear Ms. Emmyetal,

We’re truly delighted that you discovered Hum and had such a memorable experience with us. It’s wonderful to know that the space, the seasonal dishes, and the attention to detail all came together to create one of your best meals.

Your kind words about our team mean a great deal. We’re especially glad that Anh’s attentive service and Phương’s warm welcome and thoughtful sharing about the dishes made your visit even more enjoyable. We will be sure to pass along your appreciation to them.

We look forward to welcoming you back for another delightful dining journey.

Best à la Hum,

Fantastic food and service. We chose this restaurant due to its high ratings and it didn't disappoint. There was a lovely buzz with lots of local families enjoying their meal. We were welcomed and the menu shared with us. Robert approached us a kindly took us through the menu options. He was so knowledgeable and great company too explaining about the family restaurant. Delightful place. Good food and nice ambiance.

We had an unforgettable experience at Sole last night. Our bartenders, Danh and Jay, were incredibly friendly and welcoming, creating such a great atmosphere throughout the evening. If you're dining as a couple, we highly recommend sitting at the bar—it makes the experience even more special. The food was outstanding, and the cocktails were equally impressive. We would definitely come back.

OMG the food is out of this world! Fair to say as a family we sampled just about every dish on the menu. If this word is offensive then it is simply not meant this way. Every mouthful was unctuous! For me it means rich, lush, and velvety. It describes a luxurious, fatty mouthfeel that coats the palate in a satisfying way, without feeling unpleasantly greasy. Chefs kiss!

Great food and ambiance! Short ribs and baked cookie dessert were outstanding. All the other dishes were great as well and the service was extremely friendly. Reserve a table that’s further inside and not near the entry. That area gets busy as the staff cleans up at the end of dinner service.
Excellent food and wine, portions huge we couldn't eat all our food. Price extremely reasonable for quality and quantity. Will visit visit again when next on HCM

Highly recommend this place for both the fabulous food and also the spectacle of an incredibly talented team working so well together to produce it. We sat at the bar seats looking over the open kitchen and it was a great added entertainment. Cocktails were also great 🍹
Excellent experience in this restaurant, the service is impeccable. The dishes are delicious and beautifully presented.

We were walking by at lunchtime and noticed the sign for Sol, we had read about it so decided to try. We’re so happy we did! I had the duck empanada for starter, it was chock full of duck meat and the pastry was not too thick, not too thin. The sauce it came with had just the right amount of kick. BF had the beef taquitos, he also enjoyed them. I had sea bass tacos for main course and oh my goodness they were amazing! Big slabs of fish, perfectly cooked. I’m still thinking about them. BF had shrimp fajitas that looked fab. Lunch set menu was about USD 12 each for two courses (small surcharge for the shrimp). I also had an iced jasmine tea that the barman kindly tailored for me without the peach nectar, and BF had a margarita. Very good value for the size of the meals and quality of the ingredients. The restaurant had a very cool vibe too. We would have gone back if we hadn’t found it on our last day in HCMC.
Amazing Experience at Sol Kitchen & Bar – Wonderful Food, Tasty Drinks, and Brilliant Service

I had a wonderful experience dining at Sol Kitchen & Bar, and it exceeded my expectations in every way.
FOOD
The food here is great, and each dish that we ordered was extremely tasty, and beautifully made and presented. Portion sizes were generous without being too large, and it was satisfying. The even seasoning and balanced presentation shows a lot of care from the kitchen staff and chef. The food quality is a reason to come, regardless of it being a casual meal, or a celebration.

DRINKS
The drinks here are just as good as the food. The happy hour drinks are especially worth it. The cocktails are balanced, and refreshing, and happy hour makes it even better as we can try the cocktails without spending a lot of money.

SERVICE
In addition to the drinks and food, the service here is phenomenal. The staff was super friendly and created a welcoming space. They provided very good supportive services and made sure we were comfortable the whole time we were there.

The staff's friendly demeanor made the evening more enjoyable by bringing an additional personalized warmth to the evening. Overall, Sol Kitchen & Bar provides a complete dining experience — great food, amazing drinks, and top-notch service. It’s a place I would definitely go back to and would recommend to anyone who would like to have a wonderful dining experience in a relaxed and classy atmosphere.

Had the most wonderful meal at Sol’s Kitchen. Unbelievably delicious and generous serves. Rosie and Catherine were both amazing staff. 
Service, attentiveness, atmosphere and meals 10/10. 
Came twice whilst we were here in Saigon. Would highly recommend and can’t wait to come again.
A Masterclass in How Not to Run a Restaurant

I wanted to give this place a chance. I really did. But their complete incompetence at the most basic function of a restaurant, taking reservations, left me no choice but to warn everyone I know.

Let me paint the picture: I filled out their online reservation form. Nothing. Silence. So I filled it out again. Still nothing. Maybe the system was broken? I called. Once. Twice. Three times. Four times. Five times. Six times. Seven times. Each time, the phone rang into the void. No voicemail. No callback. Just dead air.

This isn't a minor inconvenience; this is a restaurant that apparently doesn't want customers. They've made it functionally impossible to give them money. How do you run an establishment in 2026 and not answer your phone or respond to reservation requests? It's not ambitious. It's not a style choice. It's negligence.

The only explanation is that this restaurant is staffed by people who either don't care or don't understand the fundamentals of hospitality. If they can't manage the front door, what does the kitchen look like?

Don't waste your time, energy, or optimism. There are dozens of restaurants in this city run by people who actually want your business. Go to any of them instead.
Last supper in Vietnam before the return.

Ceviches and fajitas with delicious wagyu beef. We were due for this beautiful variant on the menu. Go ahead without hesitation, really excellent. Rosie and Nathan did a flawless service. In addition, we made a very last minute reservation, lucky they found us a place.’

restaurant_name: A Taste Of Saigon - Ben Thanh
review_text: We came with friends and ordered different dishes so everyone could taste something. The bún chả, seafood and vegetarian options gave us plenty of variety. The staff kept the atmosphere cheerful and were quick whenever we needed anything.

restaurant_name: A Taste Of Saigon - Ben Thanh
review_text: Take advantage of the lunch break to bring the guys in the office out here to change the scenery after several days of chasing KPIs at the end of the quarter. The restaurant serves food quite quickly, about 7-10 minutes for most dishes to be ready, and they are still hot when served. I ordered rare beef pho, with a rich broth, and some crispy fried dough sticks went well with it. The price is a bit high compared to the usual lunch for office workers, but the location right in the Ben Thanh area can also be understood. Kaiden helps our group split bills quickly, which is quite convenient when there are many people.

restaurant_name: A Taste Of Saigon - Ben Thanh
review_text: Traditional pho flavor in the heart of the city

restaurant_name: A Taste Of Saigon - Ben Thanh
review_text: Being almost 60 years old, I eat quite simply, usually preferring dishes with traditional flavors. On my trip to Saigon in early autumn, I was introduced by an acquaintance and came here to try pho. The pho bowl served was hot, the broth was clear and quite light, and the beef was moderately tender. Felix greeted me politely, and during the meal, he even asked if I liked the food. What I didn't like much was that the stairs to the restaurant are a bit steep, and elderly people will need to be careful when walking. As for the food, it suits my taste quite well.

restaurant_name: A Taste Of Saigon - Ben Thanh
review_text: On the weekend, the two of us went for a walk around Le Loi, watched the streets light up, and then stopped by a restaurant for a meal. From the busy street, stepping inside, the space is much cozier. Daisy is a cute server, and when we didn't know what to choose, she suggested bun cha and salted coffee. Fragrant grilled meat, seasoned just right, goes well with vegetables. It's a pity the side vegetables are a bit little, especially for someone who likes to eat a lot of vegetables like me. Overall, it's a decent option for a couple's evening stroll around the center.

restaurant_name: Phở Việt Nam - Phạm Hồng Thái
review_text:
Easily one of the best in town. Walking in the restaurant to be hit by a strong meaty sweet basil aroma . Amazing quality beef 🥩 pho (noodle soup) served with fresh herbs 🌿 . Add a side serving of crunchy fried dough sticks to dunk in your soup. Freshly blended refreshing fruit juices .
Excellent value for money .

Be warned , they only serve beef 🥩 noodle soup. No rice No chicken No seafood.

restaurant_name: Phở Việt Nam - Phạm Hồng Thái
review_text: Just get the hot stone with wagyu and oxtail

restaurant_name: Phở Việt Nam - Phạm Hồng Thái
review_text:
Location: facing a big road 250m (Google Map said so) from Ben Thanh Market.

Store: Original store still there, but they've a larger seating area two shops to the left. Renovated with AC which was good for hot and barmy Vietnam days.

Staff: Funny to hear Aussie twang from the few server guys, probably sons of owner? They love joking around with tourists!

Food: Just go for the top - hot stone with wagyu and oxtail, with those freshly made and cut rice noodles topped with a variety of fresh herbs, surprisingly nourishing even for hot days. Thank goodness they do have strong AC. They do have other cuts and combinations of meat - might be tougher, though.

Time: Cooking, serving, customer turnaround time is really fast. Probably because everything's so tender and easy to slurp up. Even if the place if full e.g. during peak, you won't have to wait for long for a seat.

Price: Reasonable.

restaurant_name: Phở Việt Nam - Phạm Hồng Thái
review_text: Omg. First night in Vietnam and this was exactly what be needed! Amazing food. So tasty. Great staff.

restaurant_name: Phở Việt Nam - Phạm Hồng Thái
review_text: They served the Pho cold or at least warm. Fortunately, I was sitting in front of the waitstaff and they saw that the soup is not hot enough to cook the leaves, noodles and meat. They took it back thinking that they will replace a new and hot one but after waiting for a while, they returned the same bowl which is boiling with the noodles and the meats in it. Noodles became so saggy that it got melted and soup almost got absorbed. They could have just done it much better. If only I knew, I should’ve stopped them from boiling the same soup with the noodles and beef in it. Soup tasted still good but everything is not good. Super chewy beef and noodles almost became a porridge. A small cockroach is walking around my table good thing I noticed after I finished with the meat. Can’t attach vids of the cockroach.

restaurant_name: Phở Việt Nam - Phạm Hồng Thái
review_text:
Phở Việt Nam is something special. Open around the clock, and for good reason — we went twice in two days and would have gone back a third time without hesitation.

The pho is made continuously, and you can watch them slice the chicken breast directly off the bone as they prepare your bowl. The result is the most tender chicken I have ever had in a bowl of pho — impossibly silky and fresh. My husband, a chicken pho first-timer, was completely won over. The second visit was every bit as good as the first — consistent, generous, and deeply satisfying.

If you're in Ho Chi Minh City, don't walk past this one. At any hour.

restaurant_name: Phở Việt Nam - Phạm Hồng Thái
review_text: We all got small pho and it was a good quite large sized portion very happy with it. Unless you like crunchy meat I wouldn’t recommend the balls in the pho but I got the raw beef and it was delicious. Service was very attentive and made it a fun experience however I wouldn’t get the lemonade as they use tap water in it.

Returning to ANAN Saigon - @anansaigon - after a year, I was struck by how the restaurant continues to master the delicate art of evolution without alienation. Nestled within the gritty, pulsating heart of the Chợ Cũ market, the iconic “tube house” setting remains a masterclass in atmospheric contrast—a polished, vibrant sanctuary that feels entirely at home amidst the city’s chaotic energy.

@petercuongfranklin Chef Peter Cuong Franklin’s “Cuisine Mới” philosophy is on full display here. What remains most impressive is the unwavering consistency in his vision: an ability to deconstruct and elevate the soul of Vietnamese street culture through a sophisticated, refined lens. Every course is a testament to his deep respect for local roots, where the heritage of the flavors is never lost, even as they are reimagined through modern technique.

The service is warm, knowledgeable, and distinctly convivial, mirroring the unpretentious spirit of Saigon itself. It is a rare, high-octane dining experience that manages to be both intellectually stimulating and deeply comforting. 

ANAN remains a vital pulse in Vietnam’s gastronomic scene, proving that true culinary innovation is about honoring the past with every forward-thinking bite. A triumphant return.

⭐️ CONFIRMED IN THE Y&SFOOD! SAIGON DINING GUIDE 2026.

We dined last weekend at Anan Saigon, and it completely blew us away. Nestled right in the vibrant heart of the Ton That Dam Street market, Chef Peter Cuong Franklin’s one-Michelin-star gem is a brilliant beacon of "Cuisine Mới" (modern Vietnamese cuisine).

We treated ourselves to the "Culinary Journey Through Vietnam" tasting menu, and every single dish was a masterpiece. We loved how the chef paired elegance and textures in the "Foie Gras Spring Roll," while the whimsical "Le Petit Bánh Mì" was pure genius. The absolute highlight for us was the "Caviar Box Đà Lạt"—we’ve never had caviar served as a dessert before, yet this was in the pure tradition of sweet / salted Vietnamese savours. "Strangely delicious" 😋 

Beautifully focused lighting that made our plates look stunning. Combined with flawless service and multiple table visits from the friendly chef, Anan is easily one of our favorite restaurants in Asia!

Food was absolutely bust me down good. Unique and incredibly flavorful, I felt like I was having a religious experience with each bite. The low lighting and soft music made the atmosphere feel intimate, cozy—-a delicious retreat from the never ending sound that pours from the street. The bartender with the glasses and piercings was very sweet, and the drinks were also absolutely amazing. Everyone was very kind, accommodating and ensured our stomachs, hearts, and tastebuds were happy.

Extremely Unpleasant Frightening Experience

Horrible, frightening experience

I chose this restaurant after reading the excellent reviews and hearing about famous visitors who had eaten here.

Unfortunately, my wife and I had a completely different experience. From the moment we arrived, I felt extremely uncomfortable and unwelcome. I felt that we were receiving hostile looks from some staff and other people in the restaurant, and the atmosphere made both of us very uneasy.

I became uncomfortable enough that I decided we should leave immediately. I genuinely felt unsafe, which is something I have rarely experienced while travelling.

This is simply my personal experience of our visit, but it was unpleasant enough that I would not return or recommend the restaurant based on what happened to us.

First, I had the banana flower salad with chicken. It was fresh, and the vegetables were thinly sliced. The dressing was savory and gave the dish a bright, refreshing flavor. I felt that all the ingredients worked harmoniously together, and the combination of textures made it enjoyable to eat. Next, I tried the prawn stewed in a claypot with starfruit. This was a comforting, home-style dish that really captured the essence of Vietnamese home cooking. The prawns were firm and juicy, while the sauce was rich, flavorful, and well-balanced. The starfruit blended naturally into the sauce. Overall, it was a very satisfying dish. Lastly, I had the lá lốt wrapped beef. Unfortunately, this was the weakest dish of the meal. The beef was overcooked, making it less tender than it should have been. It was also under-seasoned, so without the accompanying dipping sauce, it tasted bland. However, what disappointed me the most was the service. One of the dishes I ordered, sương sâm, was never served. I waited for 30 minutes before deciding to pay the bill and leave. I was surprised that a restaurant with so many staff members could overlook such a basic part of the dining experience.

Everything is PERFECT: what is on the plate, the setting, the background music, the staff. Go there without hesitation; you will not be disappointed if you love Vietnamese cuisine; you will be in the right place. Fair price

Cuc Gach Quan offers a beautifully cosy and homely dining experience, with an atmosphere that immediately makes you feel comfortable and relaxed. The interior has a charming, lived-in feel that adds to the authenticity of the restaurant.

The food was plentiful and enjoyable, with generous portions that make it great for sharing. Service was also a standout, attentive, friendly, and efficient without being overbearing.

The only surprise was the additional charges at the end of the meal. Alongside a 10% fee, there was an extra 8% tax that wasn’t clearly explained, which was a bit confusing.

Overall, it’s a lovely spot with great food, excellent service, and a warm atmosphere, just worth being aware of the extra charges when you dine.

Authentic and Family Friendly Dining Place

From the moment we arrived at Viet Kitchen, Renaissance Riverside Saigon, Thuy, the Navigator, and the entire team welcomed our family with exceptional warmth and genuine Vietnamese hospitality. During our stay from 28 August to 4 September 2026, they made us feel completely at home, taking special care to ensure our young child was comfortable, happy, and warmly included.

The authentic Vietnamese cuisine was a true highlight. The selection was excellent, and the Vietnamese station offered vibrant local flavours that brought the dining experience to life. We especially enjoyed the steaming pho and rich, aromatic Vietnamese coffee—both delicious, satisfying, and wonderfully authentic.

What made our experience truly memorable was the heartfelt service from every member of the team. Their friendly smiles, thoughtful attention, and sincere care created a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere for our family throughout our stay.

We will certainly return to Renaissance Riverside Hotel on our next visit to Ho Chi Minh City.

We had a wonderful experience during our stay at the Renaissance Riverside Hotel Saigon. Phat Huong was very kind, friendly, and welcoming to our family. His warm service made us feel comfortable every time we went to the restaurant, and our family really enjoyed dining there.

Had three lovely breakfasts at the Viet Kitchen as part of my stay at the Renaissance Riverside Hotel Saigon recently. Having dietary restrictions can have major impact on a hotel stay. Fortunately, the staff at the Viet Kitchen were fantastic. Ms. Merida in particular along with the delightful Ms. Thuy and Mr. Phuc carefully coordinated with the chef to ensure my preferred choices were prepared to accommodate my dietary restrictions. They also pointed out other suitable options that were available to enhance my breakfast experience. Their most friendly attitude, smiling faces and caring hospitality truly elevated my experience there to the highest level. I gratefully acknowledge and commend the Viet Kitchen staff, especially Merida, Thuy and Phuc, for their significant contribution in making my stay and experience there just delightful!

Hy vọng quý khách sẽ tiếp tục ủng hộ Bếp Mẹ Ỉn và có thêm nhiều trải nghiệm tuyệt vời tại nhà hàng.

Returning to ANAN Saigon - @anansaigon - after a year, I was struck by how the restaurant continues to master the delicate art of evolution without alienation. Nestled within the gritty, pulsating heart of the Chợ Cũ market, the iconic “tube house” setting remains a masterclass in atmospheric contrast—a polished, vibrant sanctuary that feels entirely at home amidst the city’s chaotic energy.

@petercuongfranklin Chef Peter Cuong Franklin’s “Cuisine Mới” philosophy is on full display here. What remains most impressive is the unwavering consistency in his vision: an ability to deconstruct and elevate the soul of Vietnamese street culture through a sophisticated, refined lens. Every course is a testament to his deep respect for local roots, where the heritage of the flavors is never lost, even as they are reimagined through modern technique.

The service is warm, knowledgeable, and distinctly convivial, mirroring the unpretentious spirit of Saigon itself. It is a rare, high-octane dining experience that manages to be both intellectually stimulating and deeply comforting. 

ANAN remains a vital pulse in Vietnam’s gastronomic scene, proving that true culinary innovation is about honoring the past with every forward-thinking bite. A triumphant return.

⭐️ CONFIRMED IN THE Y&SFOOD! SAIGON DINING GUIDE 2026.

We dined last weekend at Anan Saigon, and it completely blew us away. Nestled right in the vibrant heart of the Ton That Dam Street market, Chef Peter Cuong Franklin’s one-Michelin-star gem is a brilliant beacon of "Cuisine Mới" (modern Vietnamese cuisine).

We treated ourselves to the "Culinary Journey Through Vietnam" tasting menu, and every single dish was a masterpiece. We loved how the chef paired elegance and textures in the "Foie Gras Spring Roll," while the whimsical "Le Petit Bánh Mì" was pure genius. The absolute highlight for us was the "Caviar Box Đà Lạt"—we’ve never had caviar served as a dessert before, yet this was in the pure tradition of sweet / salted Vietnamese savours. "Strangely delicious" 😋 

Beautifully focused lighting that made our plates look stunning. Combined with flawless service and multiple table visits from the friendly chef, Anan is easily one of our favorite restaurants in Asia!

Food was absolutely bust me down good. Unique and incredibly flavorful, I felt like I was having a religious experience with each bite. The low lighting and soft music made the atmosphere feel intimate, cozy—-a delicious retreat from the never ending sound that pours from the street. The bartender with the glasses and piercings was very sweet, and the drinks were also absolutely amazing. Everyone was very kind, accommodating and ensured our stomachs, hearts, and tastebuds were happy.

Anan always provides top notch quality food and services to me and my friends . 
Services provided by Daniel the services crew is top tier he ensure we are in good hands and ensure all are good.

Five stars to Aaan and to Daniel too

What a wonderful place for High Tea! Stunning City views from Level 48 of the Iconic Landmark 81. We booked a 3:30pm time slot on purpose to enjoy the carefully crafted Vietnamese style Afternoon Tea with bottomless tea and coffee. Each of the delectable morsels hand crafted by expert chefs was a delight to behold. One thing of note was the unusual ratio of savoury to sweet with the majority of our fare being savoury. This particularly pleased my Chef wife who prefers savoury to sweet. We finished in time to witness a burning red sunset over the Saigon skyline sipping some exquisite liqueur patiently awaiting the light show of buildings to ignite the evening sky. Our waitress for the afternoon and evening, Bella, performed her duties inexplicably. In fact all of the staff were very attentive and respectful and thanked us in person when leaving which we both thought was a lovely touch.

Window view looking over the city, unfortunately outside was closed but was still a good view.

Dear Valued Guest,

Thank you for taking the time to share your experience with us.

Regarding the ingredients in your bún bò, our standard serving is prepared with a specific proportion of both beef shank and blood pudding. However, we understand that everyone has different preferences. For future visits, please feel free to let our staff know your preferences when ordering. We are always happy to customize the dish to your liking, such as removing any ingredients you do not enjoy.

As for the broth, we understand that taste is very subjective, and we are sorry that our flavor profile did not suit your personal palate on this occasion. We always strive to maintain our traditional recipe, and we truly value your honest input. Please be assured that we have shared your comments directly with our Head Chef to review the dish and ensure our quality standards are consistently maintained.

Thank you once again for your constructive feedback. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back and provide you with a dining experience that better suits your taste.

restaurant_name: A Taste Of Saigon - Ben Thanh
review_text: We came with friends and ordered different dishes so everyone could taste something. The bún chả, seafood and vegetarian options gave us plenty of variety. The staff kept the atmosphere cheerful and were quick whenever we needed anything.

restaurant_name: A Taste Of Saigon - Ben Thanh
review_text: Take advantage of the lunch break to bring the guys in the office out here to change the scenery after several days of chasing KPIs at the end of the quarter. The restaurant serves food quite quickly, about 7-10 minutes for most dishes to be ready, and they are still hot when served. I ordered rare beef pho, with a rich broth, and some crispy fried dough sticks went well with it. The price is a bit high compared to the usual lunch for office workers, but the location right in the Ben Thanh area can also be understood. Kaiden helps our group split bills quickly, which is quite convenient when there are many people.

review_text: Traditional pho flavor in the heart of the city

restaurant_name: A Taste Of Saigon - Ben Thanh
review_text: Being almost 60 years old, I eat quite simply, usually preferring dishes with traditional flavors. On my trip to Saigon in early autumn, I was introduced by an acquaintance and came here to try pho. The pho bowl served was hot, the broth was clear and quite light, and the beef was moderately tender. Felix greeted me politely, and during the meal, he even asked if I liked the food. What I didn't like much was that the stairs to the restaurant are a bit steep, and elderly people will need to be careful when walking. As for the food, it suits my taste quite well.

restaurant_name: A Taste Of Saigon - Ben Thanh
review_text: On the weekend, the two of us went for a walk around Le Loi, watched the streets light up, and then stopped by a restaurant for a meal. From the busy street, stepping inside, the space is much cozier. Daisy is a cute server, and when we didn't know what to choose, she suggested bun cha and salted coffee. Fragrant grilled meat, seasoned just right, goes well with vegetables. It's a pity the side vegetables are a bit little, especially for someone who likes to eat a lot of vegetables like me. Overall, it's a decent option for a couple's evening stroll around the center.

Enjoyed their business lunch with the girls - always liked their elegant and quiet atmosphere even though they were in bustling District 1. Though prices have increased over the years, it's still reasonable for the quality of their dishes. From the starter of cobia, to their mains seabass and duck confit, to escargot (which we ordered separately) and choux dessert - loved their doneness and exquisite plating. A culinary pearl in the heart of Saigon.

Wonderful experience at this amazing location, everything about this restaurant is incredible,the service, the atmosphere and most importantly the food! The preparation and presentation of every dish was amazing, I always appreciate the details and in this restaurant they are definitely detail oriented. 
For starters we had the escargot which were perfect and oozing with rich butter and garlic, they were accompanied by slices of garlic bread. 
For our mains we went with the duck breast cooked to perfection and with the best New Zealand lamb chops I’ve had in a long while. Both dishes were accompanied by veggies and wonderful sauces. 
Finally, we were treated to their complimentary dessert which is just delicious. 
Our meal was accompanied by the sounds of a marvelous saxophonist with made our evening that much more unforgettable. 
This was our last dinner in HCMC and we certainly enjoyed what has been a great trip to this beautiful land.
Beyond perfect in every way. Best in Saigon

Beste Arnicdewinter,
Hartelijk dank voor uw mooie 4-sterren review en uw eerlijke beschrijving van uw bezoek aan Secret Garden Vietnamese Restaurant. Wij zijn erg blij te horen dat u onze locatie als een "bijzondere ervaring" heeft ervaren.
U heeft helemaal gelijk: de weg naar ons restaurant – door een donker steegje, langs scooters en via een trap van 8 verdiepingen – is inderdaad onverwacht en niet voor iedereen. Maar juist deze unieke toegang leidt naar ons groene dakterras, een oase van rust en sfeer boven de drukte van de stad. Fijn om te horen dat u de gemeenschappelijke tafel als een leuke kans op nieuwe ontmoetingen heeft ervaren – het delen van een maaltijd met andere reizigers is inderdaad een van de mooie aspecten van ons restaurant. En natuurlijk zijn we vooral trots op uw compliment over het eten: authentiek Vietnamees, gewoon erg lekker. Dat is waar wij elke dag ons best voor doen.
We hopen u snel nog eens te mogen verwelkomen, misschien met een reservering voor een nog comfortabelere ervaring. Tot binnenkort!

restaurant_name: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese Cuisine & Vegetarian Food
review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I had a wonderful experience at De Tham Restaurant, and I especially want to recognize my server, Anna. She was extremely polite, patient, attentive, and genuinely helpful throughout my meal.

What impressed me most was her initiative. I’m visiting Vietnam and still learning how some Vietnamese dishes are traditionally eaten. Anna didn’t just bring my food and walk away. She took the time to come over, help cut the pork for me, and explain how to eat it with the rice paper. When I thought I needed to dip the rice paper in water, she patiently explained that it was already soft and ready to use.

Those may seem like small things, but when you’re a visitor experiencing unfamiliar food, that kind of patience and hospitality makes a big difference. I never felt rushed or uncomfortable asking questions.

The food was delicious, but Anna’s service made the experience even better. She was warm, professional, patient, and attentive without being overbearing. Thank you, Anna, for making my meal such an enjoyable experience. I would gladly come back again. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Best dim sum in Ho Chi Minh city!!!
We came here because we fancied some Dim Sum and boy did they deliver. We took advantage of the All you can eat offer and when bombarded by the sheer bounty of choice we were deftly guided by Thuy our waitress, who among our choices suggested some excellent items we would have missed. The siu mai in particular was utterly divine: meaty, satisfying and absolutely delicious. Other must eats include the mustard and mayo prawns, the beef in black pepper sauce, and the charcoal prawn and chive dim sum.
You MUST visit this place. Exceptional value and fantastic quality. I would absolutely eat here again.

Delicious food, beautiful chill space, friendly and dedicated staff, especially Ms. Thuy

I had a wonderful dining experience at Kabin! The food was absolutely delicious, and all the staff were incredibly friendly, sweet, and attentive. They took such great care of me throughout the whole meal.
A special thank you to Ms.Tu and Mr.Hieu, who kindly checked in on my family and thoughtfully recommended some really delicious dishes for our meal. Their genuine care and attention made the experience even more special.
I will definitely come back to Kabin, not only for the great food but also for the warm, attentive, and heartfelt service. Highly recommended!

Had a really enjoyable experience here. The restaurant has a beautiful atmosphere that feels elegant without being too formal or stuffy. The dim sum was delicious, fresh, and beautifully presented, with each dish having its own unique flavor. Our Trân and Tiến were both incredibly friendly, and attentive throughout the meal. They made us feel very welcome and took the time to recommend dishes and check in on us without being intrusive. Overall, great food, lovely ambiance, and excellent service. Definitely a place I’d happily come back to.

Extremely Unpleasant Frightening Experience

Horrible, frightening experience

I chose this restaurant after reading the excellent reviews and hearing about famous visitors who had eaten here.

Unfortunately, my wife and I had a completely different experience. From the moment we arrived, I felt extremely uncomfortable and unwelcome. I felt that we were receiving hostile looks from some staff and other people in the restaurant, and the atmosphere made both of us very uneasy.

I became uncomfortable enough that I decided we should leave immediately. I genuinely felt unsafe, which is something I have rarely experienced while travelling.

This is simply my personal experience of our visit, but it was unpleasant enough that I would not return or recommend the restaurant based on what happened to us.

First, I had the banana flower salad with chicken. It was fresh, and the vegetables were thinly sliced. The dressing was savory and gave the dish a bright, refreshing flavor. I felt that all the ingredients worked harmoniously together, and the combination of textures made it enjoyable to eat. Next, I tried the prawn stewed in a claypot with starfruit. This was a comforting, home-style dish that really captured the essence of Vietnamese home cooking. The prawns were firm and juicy, while the sauce was rich, flavorful, and well-balanced. The starfruit blended naturally into the sauce. Overall, it was a very satisfying dish. Lastly, I had the lá lốt wrapped beef. Unfortunately, this was the weakest dish of the meal. The beef was overcooked, making it less tender than it should have been. It was also under-seasoned, so without the accompanying dipping sauce, it tasted bland. However, what disappointed me the most was the service. One of the dishes I ordered, sương sâm, was never served. I waited for 30 minutes before deciding to pay the bill and leave. I was surprised that a restaurant with so many staff members could overlook such a basic part of the dining experience.

Everything is PERFECT: what is on the plate, the setting, the background music, the staff. Go there without hesitation; you will not be disappointed if you love Vietnamese cuisine; you will be in the right place. Fair price
Cosy Atmosphere, Great Food! Just Watch the Extra Charges

Cuc Gach Quan offers a beautifully cosy and homely dining experience, with an atmosphere that immediately makes you feel comfortable and relaxed. The interior has a charming, lived-in feel that adds to the authenticity of the restaurant.

The food was plentiful and enjoyable, with generous portions that make it great for sharing. Service was also a standout, attentive, friendly, and efficient without being overbearing.

The only surprise was the additional charges at the end of the meal. Alongside a 10% fee, there was an extra 8% tax that wasn’t clearly explained, which was a bit confusing.

Overall, it’s a lovely spot with great food, excellent service, and a warm atmosphere, just worth being aware of the extra charges when you dine.

We had the shrimp salad, the clay pot pork, the clay pot shrimp, steak pho, salt and pepper soft shell crab, sour soup, and yogurt for dessert. Everything was absolutely delicious. We loved it all, especially the pork! The atmosphere was beautiful and it was overall a fantastic dinner!

We went with a local who grew up in the neighborhood. His parents eat here four times a week and I see why. Huge menu so we let him guide us. I was a bit dubious about the lemon tofu, “best in Saigon” but he was right. Brad and Angelina found it and so should you.

If talking about design of the restaurant, there are so many many restaurants and coffee shops are very beautiful in Saigon, designed like a old Vietnamese house too.

Old history and great vibe in different small areas of the restaurant. We received great recommendations from the waiter for dishes to share. 

The soup, beef rolls, spring rolls and the soft shell crab were all excellent. We also enjoyed seafood fried rice and pork and egg in clay pot. 

We will come back to this little gem

review_text: Just get the hot stone with wagyu and oxtail

restaurant_name: Phở Việt Nam - Phạm Hồng Thái
review_text:
Location: facing a big road 250m (Google Map said so) from Ben Thanh Market.

Store: Original store still there, but they've a larger seating area two shops to the left. Renovated with AC which was good for hot and barmy Vietnam days.

Staff: Funny to hear Aussie twang from the few server guys, probably sons of owner? They love joking around with tourists!

Food: Just go for the top - hot stone with wagyu and oxtail, with those freshly made and cut rice noodles topped with a variety of fresh herbs, surprisingly nourishing even for hot days. Thank goodness they do have strong AC. They do have other cuts and combinations of meat - might be tougher, though.

Time: Cooking, serving, customer turnaround time is really fast. Probably because everything's so tender and easy to slurp up. Even if the place if full e.g. during peak, you won't have to wait for long for a seat.

Price: Reasonable.

restaurant_name: Phở Việt Nam - Phạm Hồng Thái
review_text: They served the Pho cold or at least warm. Fortunately, I was sitting in front of the waitstaff and they saw that the soup is not hot enough to cook the leaves, noodles and meat. They took it back thinking that they will replace a new and hot one but after waiting for a while, they returned the same bowl which is boiling with the noodles and the meats in it. Noodles became so saggy that it got melted and soup almost got absorbed. They could have just done it much better. If only I knew, I should’ve stopped them from boiling the same soup with the noodles and beef in it. Soup tasted still good but everything is not good. Super chewy beef and noodles almost became a porridge. A small cockroach is walking around my table good thing I noticed after I finished with the meat. Can’t attach vids of the cockroach.

restaurant_name: Phở Việt Nam - Phạm Hồng Thái
review_text:
Phở Việt Nam is something special. Open around the clock, and for good reason — we went twice in two days and would have gone back a third time without hesitation.

The pho is made continuously, and you can watch them slice the chicken breast directly off the bone as they prepare your bowl. The result is the most tender chicken I have ever had in a bowl of pho — impossibly silky and fresh. My husband, a chicken pho first-timer, was completely won over. The second visit was every bit as good as the first — consistent, generous, and deeply satisfying.

If you're in Ho Chi Minh City, don't walk past this one. At any hour.

We had an unforgettable experience at Sole last night. Our bartenders, Danh and Jay, were incredibly friendly and welcoming, creating such a great atmosphere throughout the evening. If you're dining as a couple, we highly recommend sitting at the bar—it makes the experience even more special. The food was outstanding, and the cocktails were equally impressive. OMG the food is out of this world! Fair to say as a family we sampled just about every dish on the menu. If this word is offensive then it is simply not meant this way. Every mouthful was unctuous! For me it means rich, lush, and velvety. It describes a luxurious, fatty mouthfeel that coats the palate in a satisfying way, without feeling unpleasantly greasy. Chefs kiss!

We were walking by at lunchtime and noticed the sign for Sol, we had read about it so decided to try. We’re so happy we did! I had the duck empanada for starter, it was chock full of duck meat and the pastry was not too thick, not too thin. The sauce it came with had just the right amount of kick. BF had the beef taquitos, he also enjoyed them. I had sea bass tacos for main course and oh my goodness they were amazing! Big slabs of fish, perfectly cooked. I’m still thinking about them. BF had shrimp fajitas that looked fab. Lunch set menu was about USD 12 each for two courses (small surcharge for the shrimp). I also had an iced jasmine tea that the barman kindly tailored for me without the peach nectar, and BF had a margarita. Very good value for the size of the meals and quality of the ingredients. The restaurant had a very cool vibe too. We would have gone back if we hadn’t found it on our last day in HCMC.
Amazing Experience at Sol Kitchen & Bar – Wonderful Food, Tasty Drinks, and Brilliant Service

I had a wonderful experience dining at Sol Kitchen & Bar, and it exceeded my expectations in every way.
FOOD
The food here is great, and each dish that we ordered was extremely tasty, and beautifully made and presented. Portion sizes were generous without being too large, and it was satisfying. The even seasoning and balanced presentation shows a lot of care from the kitchen staff and chef. The food quality is a reason to come, regardless of it being a casual meal, or a celebration.

DRINKS
The drinks here are just as good as the food. The happy hour drinks are especially worth it. The cocktails are balanced, and refreshing, and happy hour makes it even better as we can try the cocktails without spending a lot of money.

SERVICE
In addition to the drinks and food, the service here is phenomenal. The staff was super friendly and created a welcoming space. They provided very good supportive services and made sure we were comfortable the whole time we were there.

The staff's friendly demeanor made the evening more enjoyable by bringing an additional personalized warmth to the evening. Overall, Sol Kitchen & Bar provides a complete dining experience — great food, amazing drinks, and top-notch service. It’s a place I would definitely go back to and would recommend to anyone who would like to have a wonderful dining experience in a relaxed and classy atmosphere.

Had the most wonderful meal at Sol’s Kitchen. Unbelievably delicious and generous serves. Rosie and Catherine were both amazing staff. 
Service, attentiveness, atmosphere and meals 10/10. 
Came twice whilst we were here in Saigon. Would highly recommend and can’t wait to come again.
A Masterclass in How Not to Run a Restaurant

I wanted to give this place a chance. I really did. But their complete incompetence at the most basic function of a restaurant, taking reservations, left me no choice but to warn everyone I know.

Let me paint the picture: I filled out their online reservation form. Nothing. Silence. So I filled it out again. Still nothing. Maybe the system was broken? I called. Once. Twice. Three times. Four times. Five times. Six times. Seven times. Each time, the phone rang into the void. No voicemail. No callback. Just dead air.

This isn't a minor inconvenience; this is a restaurant that apparently doesn't want customers. They've made it functionally impossible to give them money. How do you run an establishment in 2026 and not answer your phone or respond to reservation requests? It's not ambitious. It's not a style choice. It's negligence.

The only explanation is that this restaurant is staffed by people who either don't care or don't understand the fundamentals of hospitality. If they can't manage the front door, what does the kitchen look like?

Don't waste your time, energy, or optimism. There are dozens of restaurants in this city run by people who actually want your business. Go to any of them instead.

Ceviches and fajitas with delicious wagyu beef. We were due for this beautiful variant on the menu. Go ahead without hesitation, really excellent. Rosie and Nathan did a flawless service. In addition, we made a very last minute reservation, lucky they found us a place.’

Fantastic!! , if you want a proper Omakase experience Yuzu is it, as a Londoner married to a Vietnamese lady, and a couple that enjoys great dining in HCM Yuzu ticks every box , 18 customers sat around the cooking station, one waiter (Ming) one chef (Anh) looked after myself, my wife and 1 single diner, Ming spoke perfect English explaining wine/sake list and at the end of the dinner the Japanese whiskeys, we chose a great red , then Ming gave us samples to try of sparkling sake which we were toasting with him, If you love sashimi and Maki then this is the experience for you , gold leaf by the tree full , dry ice every where , 14 food bites of absolute perfection, this is a honest review of a great night of quality dining, well done the Yuzu team , we will definitely be back

The other day, I enjoyed dinner at Yuzu Omakase in Ho Chi Minh City. Each dish that makes use of seasonal ingredients is beautiful and has a delicate taste that spreads in your mouth. The craftsmen's attentive commentary and hospitality allowed us to spend a luxurious time in a cozy space until the end. The volume of the course is also moderate and it is a very satisfying 5 stars!

Your satisfaction means a lot to us, and we look forward to welcoming you back for another special experience soon.

Dinner at Yuzu gave me a real sense of craftsmanship. From the first appetizer to the final dessert, every dish is full of surprises, with heart and love in the details. The interaction with the chef, in particular, made me feel the charm of omakase - the perfect combination of trust and expectation. It's a satisfying and heartwarming dining experience that's worth revisiting.

It was really nice to be here with your other half to celebrate the special day! The ingredients are fresh and delicious, especially sea urchins and oxen, and the entrance melts. It's a wonderful memory and will definitely be back again!

Yuz Omakase - Ho Chi Minh City:
 • Quality of food: Materials imported from Japan, fresh and beautifully presented and taste excellent.

👉 Suitable for experiencing advanced Japanese cuisine.

Thank you for the thoughtful review and clear breakdown! We're so pleased to hear that you enjoyed the quality of our ingredients, ambiance, and service. We look forward to welcoming you back for another refined omakase experience.

Tried the Journey menu at Yuzu and had a memorable experience. The counter setup lets you watch the chefs in action—great energy and attention to detail.

Standouts included toro, uni, and a sushi course wrapped in gold leaf. The truffle dish added a fun, unexpected twist. While some dishes were more subtle than others, the progression felt well thought-out and enjoyable.

Plan for a longer meal—it’s over 20 courses—so don’t rush. Ideal for a special occasion or if you’re curious about premium ingredients in an omakase format.

Thank you for sharing your experience with us! We're glad you enjoyed The Journey and appreciated the creativity and flow of the course. Book early to get a window seat to enjoy the view. We booked on the day and missed out on a window view but still enjoyed an amazing night.

Had the most amazing, delicious dining experience at The Albion. Not only does the food dance on your tastebuds but it is a full sensory experience. For the three of us dining, everything was exceptional. 

We also were beautifully looked after by the lovely Vy, who was attentive, explained each dish on arrival and whose gorgeous personality just shone through. 

For a culinary dining experience, in gorgeous ambience (long tall floor to ceiling windows that picture frame your view to the outside on level 23) you do not need yo look further than The Albion.

We are delighted that your experience at The Albion was a true sensory and culinary journey, from the cuisine and ambience to the panoramic views from Level 23.

A special thank you for recognizing Vy. We will be delighted to share your lovely words with her, especially your appreciation of her attentive service, storytelling, and warm personality.

We truly appreciate your recommendation and look forward to welcoming you back for another memorable experience.

Warm regards,

Guest Experience and Quality Manager

Having previously dined at Kirk Westaway's two Michelin starred restaurant, JAAN, in Singapore, when we found out that he had opened a restaurant in Ho Chi Minh City and that we were staying at the hotel we knew we had to book. Located on the 23rd floor of the Hotel Des Arts Saigon, it has sweeping views over the city. The decor is refined and restrained, with timber parquetry floors, wood panelling on the walls, timber chairs with soft red velvet lining, white marble tables - it has the feel of a classic dining area at an exclusive English men's club. 

The menu reflects Westway's vision of reimagining traditional British classics, with a refined modern twist. Rather than going to the tasting menu, we decided to be more selective and chose from the ala carte options. We decided on the smoked beef tartare and the Albion tomato for starters, followed by the roasted duck and wagyu striploin. For dessert we opted for the lemon tart and the Calamansi. The Albion tomato is a different take on JAAN's heirloom tomato but just as delicious. The beef tartare was amazing. Both the meat dishes were cooked to perfection and I could not fault the lemon tart. 

The service was impeccable, and we appreciated head chef, Chris Clarke, taking the time to chat to us about our meal. 

If you are looking for a fine dining option in Ho Chi Minh City, then this is the place you have to try - thoroughly recommend it.

Dear Dingo_dude,

Thank you for such a wonderful and detailed review of your experience at The Albion.

We are delighted that your previous experience at JAAN inspired you to discover Chef Kirk Westaway’s vision here in Ho Chi Minh City. It is wonderful to hear that you enjoyed the Albion Tomato, smoked beef tartare, roasted duck, Wagyu striploin, and lemon tart, as well as the ambience and sweeping city views.

We are especially pleased that the service complemented your dining experience, and we will be delighted to share your kind recognition with Chef Chris Clarke and the entire team.

Thank you for your generous recommendation. We look forward to welcoming you back to The Albion for another memorable evening.

Kind regards,
Tram Huynh
Guest Experience and Quality Manager
A romantic touch in the night of Ho Chi Minh.

Located on the second-to-last floor of the Hotel des Arts, the restaurant enjoys a spectacular view of Ho Chi Minh. The furnishings and lighting make the atmosphere elegant and romantic. Rich menu, and sophisticated food. Attentive and very professional service. Although I personally do not love kitchens with a view, this one stands out for the splendid open marble counter, truly remarkable. Superlative desserts. Very expensive, but it's worth it.

What a wonderful place for High Tea! Stunning City views from Level 48 of the Iconic Landmark 81. We booked a 3:30pm time slot on purpose to enjoy the carefully crafted Vietnamese style Afternoon Tea with bottomless tea and coffee. Each of the delectable morsels hand crafted by expert chefs was a delight to behold. One thing of note was the unusual ratio of savoury to sweet with the majority of our fare being savoury. This particularly pleased my Chef wife who prefers savoury to sweet. We finished in time to witness a burning red sunset over the Saigon skyline sipping some exquisite liqueur patiently awaiting the light show of buildings to ignite the evening sky. Our waitress for the afternoon and evening, Bella, performed her duties inexplicably. In fact all of the staff were very attentive and respectful and thanked us in person when leaving which we both thought was a lovely touch.

Window view looking over the city, unfortunately outside was closed but was still a good view.

Staff is amazing, we had one that had pretty good English so that made it easier for us. 

Chill vibes, very soul setting.

Food was 10/10! 
Good value for money!
Superb food, great view and fantastic staff!

review_text:
Bếp Mẹ Ỉn xin gửi lời cảm ơn chân thành đến quý khách đã dành lời khen cho Bếp ạ!

Bếp rất vui khi mình đã để lại ấn tượng tốt đẹp với quý khách bởi các món ăn và chất lượng phục vụ. Bếp Mẹ Ỉn luôn nỗ lực để xây dựng một thực đơn đa dạng đi cùng với chất lượng và giá cả hợp lý, đồng thời phát triển một đội ngũ nhân viên chuyên nghiệp, thân thiện và tận tâm, vì vậy lời khen của quý khách là một nguồn động viên rất lớn cho Bếp Mẹ Ỉn.

Hy vọng quý khách sẽ tiếp tục ủng hộ Bếp Mẹ Ỉn và có thêm nhiều trải nghiệm tuyệt vời tại nhà hàng.

Chúng tôi vô cùng hân hoan khi được biết rằng Quý khách đã có trải nghiệm ẩm thực tuyệt vời với không gian thoải mái và phong cách phục vụ ân cần từ đội ngũ của chúng tôi. Một lần nữa, cảm ơn Quý khách đã tin tưởng lựa chọn The Lounge và chúng tôi mong sớm được đón tiếp quý khách vào một ngày gần nhất. 

Trân trọng, 
Shardul Kulkarni

Book early to get a window seat to enjoy the view. We booked on the day and missed out on a window view but still enjoyed an amazing night.

Had the most amazing, delicious dining experience at The Albion. Not only does the food dance on your tastebuds but it is a full sensory experience. For the three of us dining, everything was exceptional. 

We also were beautifully looked after by the lovely Vy, who was attentive, explained each dish on arrival and whose gorgeous personality just shone through. 

For a culinary dining experience, in gorgeous ambience (long tall floor to ceiling windows that picture frame your view to the outside on level 23) you do not need yo look further than The Albion.

Dear helentR1190OJ,

Thank you for sharing such wonderful feedback!

We are delighted that your experience at The Albion was a true sensory and culinary journey, from the cuisine and ambience to the panoramic views from Level 23.

A special thank you for recognizing Vy. We will be delighted to share your lovely words with her, especially your appreciation of her attentive service, storytelling, and warm personality.

We truly appreciate your recommendation and look forward to welcoming you back for another memorable experience.

Warm regards,
Tram Huynh
Guest Experience and Quality Manager

Having previously dined at Kirk Westaway's two Michelin starred restaurant, JAAN, in Singapore, when we found out that he had opened a restaurant in Ho Chi Minh City and that we were staying at the hotel we knew we had to book. Located on the 23rd floor of the Hotel Des Arts Saigon, it has sweeping views over the city. The decor is refined and restrained, with timber parquetry floors, wood panelling on the walls, timber chairs with soft red velvet lining, white marble tables - it has the feel of a classic dining area at an exclusive English men's club. 

The menu reflects Westway's vision of reimagining traditional British classics, with a refined modern twist. Rather than going to the tasting menu, we decided to be more selective and chose from the ala carte options. We decided on the smoked beef tartare and the Albion tomato for starters, followed by the roasted duck and wagyu striploin. For dessert we opted for the lemon tart and the Calamansi. The Albion tomato is a different take on JAAN's heirloom tomato but just as delicious. The beef tartare was amazing. Both the meat dishes were cooked to perfection and I could not fault the lemon tart. 

The service was impeccable, and we appreciated head chef, Chris Clarke, taking the time to chat to us about our meal. 

If you are looking for a fine dining option in Ho Chi Minh City, then this is the place you have to try - thoroughly recommend it.

Dear Dingo_dude,

Thank you for such a wonderful and detailed review of your experience at The Albion.

We are delighted that your previous experience at JAAN inspired you to discover Chef Kirk Westaway’s vision here in Ho Chi Minh City. It is wonderful to hear that you enjoyed the Albion Tomato, smoked beef tartare, roasted duck, Wagyu striploin, and lemon tart, as well as the ambience and sweeping city views.

We are especially pleased that the service complemented your dining experience, and we will be delighted to share your kind recognition with Chef Chris Clarke and the entire team.

Thank you for your generous recommendation. We look forward to welcoming you back to The Albion for another memorable evening.

Kind regards,
Tram Huynh
Guest Experience and Quality Manager
A romantic touch in the night of Ho Chi Minh.

Located on the second-to-last floor of the Hotel des Arts, the restaurant enjoys a spectacular view of Ho Chi Minh. The furnishings and lighting make the atmosphere elegant and romantic. Rich menu, and sophisticated food. Attentive and very professional service. Although I personally do not love kitchens with a view, this one stands out for the splendid open marble counter, truly remarkable. Superlative desserts. Very expensive, but it's worth it.

Dear LucaFVG,

Thank you for your wonderful review.

We are delighted that you enjoyed the romantic atmosphere, spectacular city views, attentive service, and refined cuisine at The Albion. It is especially lovely to hear that our marble counter and desserts stood out as highlights of your evening.

We truly appreciate your kind words and are pleased that you found the experience well worth it. We look forward to welcoming you back for another memorable evening above the city.

Warm regards,
Tram Huynh
Guest Experience and Quality Manager

We had an absolutely amazing experience at The Albion. Since this was my wife’s first fine dining experience and we were celebrating our 7th anniversary, the team went above and beyond to make it unforgettable. A huge thank you to the Restaurant Manager, Tyler, who fantastically curated a special menu to ensure my wife felt comfortable and delighted. Our server, Wendy, was also wonderful, guiding us effortlessly through every course.

The culinary journey was fantastic, from the very first bite of the canapés to the final Chocolate Hazelnut dessert. If you visit, you must try the Albion Tomato - take your time to enjoy it slowly, the flavors will leave you speechless.

The drinks were equally impressive. Thank you to mixologists Thu and Học for the Purple Bloom cocktails, which not only looked fabulous but tasted incredible. We also want to thank the sommelier, Adam, who introduced us to a phenomenal bottle of wine that truly elevated our evening.

Finally, a special shoutout to Cecilia, Viola, Tracy, Grace, and Evelyn for their thoughtful arrangements and the beautiful anniversary gift for my wife. Thank you all for a perfect night!

Dear Huy N,

Thank you for choosing The Albion to celebrate such a special milestone. We are delighted to know that your 7th anniversary — and your wife’s very first fine dining experience — became such a memorable evening.

Your wonderful recognition of Tyler, Wendy, Thu, Học, Adam, Cecilia, Viola, Tracy, Grace, and Evelyn means a great deal to us, and we will proudly share your kind words with the entire team. We are also thrilled that the Albion Tomato, Purple Bloom cocktails, and the culinary journey made such an impression.

It was truly our pleasure to be part of your celebration. We look forward to welcoming you both back for many more special moments together.

Warm regards,
Tram Huynh
Guest Experience and Quality Manager

Ultimate location & great ambience but food quality is deteriorating. The amuse-bouche selection in the tasting menu was barely edible including a scallop way past expiration and the wagyu beef was under impressive. An amazing smoked salad and a tasty white fish brightened the experience, but overall, a disappointing experience. I really hope this feedback can be taken constructively as I love the staff & atmosphere

Dear D7187MUwilliamk,

Thank you for sharing your candid and constructive feedback with us.

While we are pleased that you continue to enjoy our team, atmosphere, and some highlights of the menu, we are truly sorry that the overall dining experience fell short of your expectations. We are particularly concerned by your comments regarding the amuse-bouches, scallop, and Wagyu beef, and have shared them with our culinary team for careful review.

We genuinely appreciate your feedback and your continued affection for The Albion. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back and provide the experience you have come to expect from us.

Warm regards,
Tram Huynh
Guest Experience and Quality Manager
Michelin level restaurant with great views and ambience
Really excellent restaurant at Michellin standard. Great service and ambience....and the food is simply amazing. Really a fantastic all round experience. So good, I ate there twice in a week!

Dear U2735Gmarkl,

Thank you for your fantastic feedback!

We are delighted that you enjoyed the food, service, ambience, and beautiful city views. Knowing that you enjoyed the experience so much that you visited us twice in one week is truly the best compliment we could receive!

We look forward to welcoming you back to The Albion again soon.

Warm regards,
Tram Huynh
Guest Experience and Quality Manager

We ate here as it is located in the hotel we stayed & also it was raining heavily in the evening, so we did not want to go out of the hotel. The service is very good. I ordered the BBQ lobster & it tastes delicious with the sauce. My husband ordered the lamb rack but he did not like the way it was cooked. The ambience of the restaurant is good & can enjoy the good view of Ho Chi Minh City since it is located at high floor.

Dear CFSMCHERYL,

Thank you for dining with us and for sharing your experience.

We are delighted that you enjoyed the ambience, city views, attentive service, and especially the BBQ lobster. We are sorry, however, that the lamb rack was not prepared to your husband’s preference, and we will certainly share your feedback with our culinary team.

We appreciate your visit and hope to welcome you both back for another enjoyable evening at The Albion.

Warm regards,
Tram Huynh
Guest Experience and Quality Manager

We took the set menu with 5 course , started with excellent amuse bouches all dishes were perfectly cooked and nicely presented the sea bream very tasty , Wagyu beef just right , nice desert as well , you could fell the fusion between Europe and Asia in every dishes , attentive service , nice cosy atmosphere , 
Very good value for money , they are on the right track to get a one star Michelin iif they continue to improve and propose more innovative cuisine 
Will go back for sure

Dear DCapion11,

Thank you for your wonderful and encouraging feedback!

We are delighted that you enjoyed our five-course menu, from the amuse-bouches to the sea bream, Wagyu beef and dessert, as well as the balance of European and Asian influences throughout the experience.

Your kind words about our cuisine, attentive service and atmosphere mean a great deal to the team. We also truly appreciate your encouraging comments about our journey ahead — they inspire us to keep evolving and creating memorable experiences.

We look forward to welcoming you back again soon!

Warm regards,
Tram Huynh
Guest Experience and Quality Manager

Cảm ơn bạn đã ghé The Albion và chia sẻ trải nghiệm rất chân thật và đáng yêu.

Chúng mình rất tiếc khi khẩu phần của bữa tối chưa đủ để hai bạn cảm thấy “no bụng”, dù hy vọng rằng hương vị và trải nghiệm tại The Albion vẫn để lại một vài ấn tượng đẹp.

Cảm ơn bạn đã thử trải nghiệm cùng chúng mình, và hy vọng sẽ có dịp được chào đón hai bạn quay lại trong tương lai.

Thân mến,
Tram Huynh
Guest Experience and Quality Manager
Perfect evening @ The Albion ... Thanx Kirk & Vy !
We had a perfect evening at The Albion in Saigon ! The food and the wine (tasting menu with wine pairing) were excellent ! The service from Vy was fantastic ... we will be back !!!

Dear F4066EDpeterc,

Thank you for your wonderful feedback!

We are delighted to hear that you had a perfect evening at The Albion and thoroughly enjoyed the tasting menu, wine pairing, and especially the fantastic service from Vy.

Your kind words will certainly be shared with Vy, Chef Kirk, and the entire team. We are already looking forward to welcoming you back for another memorable evening!

Warm regards,
Tram Huynh
Guest Experience and Quality Manager

If you are a foodie, then this restaurant is a must during your stay in Ho Chi Minh. We are always looking to try new flavours and the tasting menu with wine pairing was a great way to end our trip to Vietnam. 
The flavours and textures of each dish blended perfectly and standout ingredients like caviar and white truffle (freshly shaven at your table) were showcased perfectly in their respective dishes. 
My final dish was a carrot cake and it was one of the nicest sweet dishes I have ever tried. 
The wine pairings worked well and I’m glad we went for this option over the à la carte choices which also looked very tempting.

Dear TracyTas,

Thank you for sharing such wonderful feedback!

We are delighted that our tasting menu and wine pairing provided a memorable finale to your Vietnam journey. It is especially rewarding to hear how much you enjoyed the balance of flavors and textures, from the caviar and freshly shaved white truffle to the carrot cake — certainly a lovely way to finish the experience!

Your kind words will be proudly shared with our culinary and service teams. Thank you for recommending The Albion, and we hope to welcome you back for another culinary journey on your next visit to Ho Chi Minh City.

Kind regards,
Tram Huynh
Guest Experience and Quality Manager
Kirk knocked it out of the park again. Each dish elevating the experience until the end. We will be back again.

They knocked it out of the park again. Each dish elevating the experience until the end. We will be back again.l and what a great time with a super venue, great food and fun. 

Some of the old favourites and some new ones experiences that just sent this up another flight of stairs

Dear STS9,

Thank you for returning to The Albion and for such fantastic feedback!

We are thrilled to hear that we delivered another memorable experience and that each dish continued to elevate the journey, with a wonderful mix of familiar favorites and exciting new creations.

Knowing that you had such a great time means a lot to our entire team. We already look forward to welcoming you back again for the next experience!

Warm regards,
Tram Huynh
Guest Experience and Quality Manager

Earlier this year, we had attended a winemaker dinner, which was an enjoyable experience, so we wanted to go back and try it again. My wife and I each opted for the chef's selection meal with wine pairing. It was well worth being a bit adventurous, instead of simply going ala carte. The food and wine pairings were spot on, while the service was incredibly attentive. I recommend simply going there with an open mind on what you'll be eating and let the chef take it to the next level. You'll be glad to you!

Dear BryanLovesWine,

Thank you for returning to The Albion and for sharing such wonderful feedback.

We are delighted that you and your wife chose to experience our Chef’s Selection Menu with wine pairing and enjoyed the journey from beginning to end. It is especially rewarding to hear that the pairings, culinary creativity, and attentive service made the experience worthwhile.

We truly appreciate your recommendation to come with an open mind and let our Chef lead the experience — we could not have said it better ourselves!

We look forward to welcoming you both back for another culinary adventure.

Warm regards,
Tram Huynh
Guest Experience and Quality Manager
Great ambiance, but food falling short of excellence

Beautiful restaurant and bar with stunning picture windows of the city - staff are very friendly and the chef served a dish to us at the table and was very talkative. We had the tasting menu with wine pairing and the the first half of the meal we rated very highly and suprised the restaurant has not been awarded a star yet, but as the courses went on, the dishes failed to deliver and the wine pairings for the red were quite disappointing with the 2014 Bordeaux well past its best. The main disappintment was the main course of wagyu beef which was a very small portion and very low grade beef, but the other elements on the plate were very good. Service was unfortunately lacking, not clearing our table of towels and empty glasses and a long wait after our dessert to clear plates... we ended up requesting the cheque before the last course had arrived. Overall a nice experience, and we would recommend, but maybe just order a la carte and avoid the wine pairings.

Dear 832petes,

Thank you for taking the time to share such detailed and constructive feedback.

We are pleased that you enjoyed the ambience, city views, warm interaction with our team and Chef, as well as the earlier courses of your tasting experience. At the same time, we are sorry that the experience became less consistent as the evening progressed.

Your comments regarding the Wagyu course, the red wine pairings, particularly the 2014 Bordeaux, and the service delays have been taken seriously and shared with both our Culinary and Service teams for review. The lack of attention to clearing your table and the extended wait towards the end of your meal certainly did not reflect the level of service we aim to provide.

We truly appreciate your balanced feedback and your recommendation despite these shortcomings. We hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back and deliver a more consistently exceptional experience from beginning to end.

Warm regards,
Tram Huynh
Guest Experience and Quality Manager

restaurant_name: A Taste Of Saigon - Old Market
review_text: We came here for lunch just after landing in HCM and what a great find this place turned out to be! They cater really well to dietary requirements, specifically gluten free/cealiac. Dear Mr./Ms. B & L,

Thank you very much for choosing Pizza 4P’s and for taking the time to share your experience with us.

We are truly delighted to know that you enjoyed our food and would consider visiting us again.
