Outstanding location! All rooms feature sea views, with 4-5 offering 3-side ocean views. Sunrise from bed, oceanfront pool, full kitchen, washing machine, and charcoal BBQ grill. Buying fresh seafood at the nearby local market made outdoor family grilling super fun!

Dear Mr./Ms. Dream27080980252,

Thank you very much for choosing Pizza 4P’s Le Thanh Ton and for taking the time to leave us a review.
We truly appreciate your feedback and support. Your review is a great encouragement for our team to continue striving to provide enjoyable experiences for our guests.

With the goal of always providing guests with “WOW” experiences, we sincerely hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back to Pizza 4P’s in the future.

Thank you once again, and we wish you a wonderful day.
Best regards,
Pizza 4P’s Team

We visited 4P’s Pizza at D1Mension Residences, and the food was absolutely awesome and delicious. Unfortunately, there were a couple of things that took away from an otherwise enjoyable dining experience.

While serving the dishes, the staff held the food in their hands while explaining the dishes to us from very close range. Because they were speaking so close to the food, I was concerned about saliva droplets potentially reaching the dishes. I found this quite unpleasant and felt that it could be handled in a more hygienic way.

The toilet was another disappointment. It was quite smelly and did not appear to be very clean or well maintained, which was surprising given the restaurant's overall standard.

The food itself was excellent, but I hope the restaurant will pay more attention to food-handling and hygiene practices. These small details can make a big difference to the overall dining experience.

Dear Mr/.Ms. KT,

My name is Minh Ta – Restaurant Manager at Pizza 4P’s Vo Van Kiet. 
On behalf of our team, I sincerely apologize that your recent visit fell short of your expectations due to issues with our service hygiene and restroom cleanliness. We truly appreciate you choosing Pizza 4P’s and taking the time to share your honest feedback with us.

While we are delighted to hear that you enjoyed our food, we take your hygiene concerns very seriously. We have immediately retrained our service partner to maintain a safe distance when presenting dishes to prevent any health concerns. Additionally, as the restroom facilities are shared with the building, we are actively working with the building management to ensure they are strictly maintained and kept in the best possible condition at all times.

Thank you for helping us improve our standards. We hope to have another opportunity to welcome you back and provide you with a much better experience in the future. Wishing you a wonderful day ahead!

Sincerely,
Minh Ta – Restaurant Manager, Pizza 4P’s Vo Van Kiet

We visited here, having heard lots of good reports on the 4P's chain. It's a hard place to get a booking, so we ended up there quite late. Service was good, and the restaurant was nice, but the pizzas were just ok. The toppings were ok, but it just seemed like the pizzas weren't cooked properly. Having heard all the recommendations, we were quite disappointed, and we probably wouldn't return.

Dear Mr/Ms Craig M,

My name is Loi Vien, Restaurant Manager at Pizza 4P's Le Thanh Ton.
First of all, I would like to sincerely thank you for choosing Pizza 4P's Le Thanh Ton and for taking the time to share your feedback about your experience.

I am truly sorry to learn that the quality of the pizza during your recent visit did not meet your expectations, particularly regarding the pizza not being baked as expected. restaurant_name: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese Cuisine & Vegetarian Food
review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I had a wonderful experience at De Tham Restaurant, and I especially want to recognize my server, Anna. She was extremely polite, patient, attentive, and genuinely helpful throughout my meal.

What impressed me most was her initiative. I’m visiting Vietnam and still learning how some Vietnamese dishes are traditionally eaten. Anna didn’t just bring my food and walk away. She took the time to come over, help cut the pork for me, and explain how to eat it with the rice paper. When I thought I needed to dip the rice paper in water, she patiently explained that it was already soft and ready to use.

Those may seem like small things, but when you’re a visitor experiencing unfamiliar food, that kind of patience and hospitality makes a big difference. I never felt rushed or uncomfortable asking questions.

The food was delicious, but Anna’s service made the experience even better. She was warm, professional, patient, and attentive without being overbearing. Thank you, Anna, for making my meal such an enjoyable experience. I would gladly come back again. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Dear Wander00071287632,

Thank you so much for visiting us again and for taking the time to share your review! We are thrilled to hear that after two years, your experience at Secret Garden Vietnamese Restaurant was just as fantastic as your first visit.

It is wonderful to know you enjoyed our food, cocktails, and warm rooftop atmosphere. We also appreciate you giving a fun shoutout to the climb—those stairs certainly make reaching the top even more rewarding!

Thank you for your high recommendation, and we look forward to welcoming you back for another wonderful evening in Saigon!

Warm regards,

Owner, Secret Garden Vietnamese Restaurant
This was our first meal on our three week visit to Vietnam and we loved it. Great food, fairly reasonably priced and a lovely roof-top location. Well worth the hike up the stairs!

Dear 914rupertu,

Welcome to Vietnam! We are so honored to have been your very first meal on your three-week journey.

Thank you for the wonderful 4-star review! We are delighted that you loved our rooftop setting, food, and pricing—and that you found the climb up the stairs well worth the effort!

We hope you have an incredible time exploring the rest of Vietnam, and we'd love to welcome you back anytime you're in Ho Chi Minh City again.

Warm regards,

An Ngoc & The Secret Garden Team

If you can be bothered climbing four sets of stairs in an old apartment block situated in an alley off a main thoroughfare in downtown Saigon, you will be rewarded.
There you'll find a cool rooftop restaurant festooned with lanterns overlooking the lights of Saigon.
Food was sensational and not pricey. 
50 AUD fed two of us more than satisfactorily including a couple of beers and wine.
Secret Garden is hidden gem!
Going back for round two tomorrow night!!

Hi Steve,

Thank you so much for taking the time to share your wonderful experience!

We are absolutely thrilled that you enjoyed the "secret" journey up our stairs and found the lantern-lit rooftop atmosphere and views of Saigon worth the climb. It is fantastic to hear that the food was sensational and that we could provide great value for your dinner.

Knowing that you are already planning to come back for round two is the highest compliment our team could ask for! We look forward to welcoming you both back tonight for another memorable evening.

Safe travels, and see you soon!

Warm regards,

We visited here with a large group last year so were keen to try again with just the four of us. Amazing again!!! The garden ambience is so peaceful and cool. Exceptional wine and with perfect menu - 3 set menus (Asian, Western or Vegetarian). A must!

Hi Alison,

Thank you so much for visiting us again and for taking the time to leave such a lovely review!

We are absolutely delighted to welcome you back, this time with a smaller group, and thrilled to hear that your experience was just as amazing as the first. It’s wonderful to know that you enjoyed our peaceful garden ambience, the wine selection, and found our set menus—whether Asian, Western, or Vegetarian—to be a perfect fit for your evening.

We truly appreciate your recommendation and look forward to welcoming you back from Perth for your third visit whenever you are next in Saigon!

Warm regards,

Secret Garden, Ho Chi Minh City
The only good thing about this place is the rooftop location. The terrace on the 5th floor looks nice and has potential — but that’s where the positives end.
Getting there is already a bad start: the elevator wasn’t working, and you have to go through a rather shady, uncomfortable entrance. Not exactly a welcoming experience.
The food was disappointing. What we received looked quite different from what was shown in the menu — misleading at best.
The service, however, was the worst part. The waiter was rude, dismissive, and clearly uninterested. When we asked simple questions, the attitude was sharp and unfriendly. No professionalism at all. When we left, there wasn’t even a basic goodbye.
Overall, a very unpleasant experience and definitely not what you expect from a place with such a nice setting. A real disappointment — especially as it happened at the end of an otherwise great holiday...
Takes a bit of finding….past motorcycles and up four floors….but definitely worth it. Food was great & we recommend.

Dear Guest,

Thank you so much for sharing your experience! We love that you described us as a "Hidden Gem."

You are absolutely right—finding us is part of the adventure! Navigating past the motorcycles and climbing those four flights of stairs is the local way to discover the best spots in Saigon. We are so glad you felt the effort was "definitely worth it" once you reached our rooftop.

It’s wonderful to know you enjoyed the food and would recommend us to others. We look forward to welcoming you back for another peaceful escape above the city streets!

Warm regards,

The Management
Secret Garden Vietnamese Restaurant
158 Pasteur, Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City

Yes, the entrance can be off putting. Despite the motorbikes and unclear entrance (as well as a dead mouse at the bottom of 4 flights of stairs) we really enjoyed ourselves once we made it to the rooftop. We were seated quickly and our food arrived in less than 10 minutes. the rooftop area is beautiful and everything we ordered was good. my husband particularly liked the bbq chicken and the garlic fried rice and spring rolls were great. Would recommend!

Dear 352natr,

Thank you for sharing such a detailed review of your visit to Secret Garden. We are thrilled that you enjoyed the atmosphere and the food once you reached our rooftop!

First, please accept our sincerest apologies for the unpleasant sight you encountered at the bottom of the stairs. While the entrance and alleyway are shared spaces, we strive to maintain a clean environment for our guests and will coordinate with the building management to ensure the stairwell is monitored more closely.

On a brighter note, we are so happy to hear that your husband loved the BBQ chicken, and that the garlic fried rice and spring rolls hit the mark! Our kitchen team takes pride in serving fresh, traditional flavors quickly, so it’s great to know your meal arrived in less than 10 minutes.

We appreciate your recommendation and your "adventurous spirit" in looking past the entrance to find us. We hope to welcome you back again soon for another beautiful evening above the city!

Warm regards,

The Management
Secret Garden Vietnamese Restaurant
158 Pasteur, Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City

This was my first time visiting this Vietnamese restaurant. I had to go up four floors, and the place is located right on the rooftop, with a unique style that feels completely different from the lively and bustling vibe of Ho Chi Minh City.

The restaurant seemed quite crowded, with a large number of foreign customers like me. The menu offers a wide variety of choices. I would recommend trying the grilled beef and shrimp, as well as the grilled fish.

As for drinks, I found them really good. I highly recommend ordering the “Miss Saigon” cocktail and another one called “Hoi An Story” (or something like that) — they were both unique and delicious. The bartender was very professional, especially when she helped suggest flavors based on my preferences.

I would definitely recommend coming here and giving it a try.

Dear Guest,

Thank you so much for choosing Secret Garden for your first Vietnamese dining experience in Saigon! We are delighted that you enjoyed the "hidden" rooftop atmosphere and found it to be a peaceful escape from the bustling city below.

It is fantastic to hear your recommendations for the grilled beef, shrimp, and fish—these are indeed some of our favorites! We are especially proud that you enjoyed our signature cocktails. Our bartender will be thrilled to hear your kind words; she takes great care in crafting drinks like "Miss Saigon" and "Hoi An Story" to match our guests' personal tastes.

Thank you for the high recommendation and for sharing your experience with other travelers. We look forward to welcoming you back to our rooftop for more unique flavors and professional service!

Warm regards,

The Management
Secret Garden Vietnamese Restaurant
158 Pasteur, Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City

Horrible is the only word that fits: at the bottom of a dark courtyard where dozens of motorcycles are parked, you have to climb 4 awful floors on foot because the elevator is condemned by chains and padlocks. It's already sad, dirty, unseemly. Arriving on the top floor, we see a kitchen (photographed by another customer and visible on this site), not very tasty. Let's go into the large open-air room. Well, we're reassured that sounds more inviting. We wait... A lot... After twenty minutes, I get up and go check with a waiter to finally take our order (other people entered after us had already been able to place an order.)
The dishes are coming... Mine was really not good: the pork I had to roll in a stiff rice leaf with some vegetables and herbs was overcooked and totally tasteless. I left much of the dish. 
Belly a little hollow, I thought I was going to have dessert for once. Bad took me: again a good 15 minutes waiting without any server moving to see if by chance a client would need anything. So I finally get up. I approach the kitchen: one of the waiters was on his cell phone and two waitresses were playing with a small dog... I demand the menu again. We study the short dessert menu... then wait. Nobody's coming. We ended up getting paid and leaving. Don’t waste your time, breath and money: go your way.
Lovely roof top experience with nice food.

It’s this sense of discovery that makes dining with us so special.
Your kind words mean a lot to our entire team. We look forward to welcoming you back soon for another memorable meal above the bustling streets of District 1!
Warm regards,
The Secret Garden Team
158 Pasteur, Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

Thank you again for choosing Secret Garden for your dinner in Ho Chi Minh City. We hope to welcome you back soon for another memorable meal above the city streets!

The Secret Garden Team
158 Pasteur, Bến Nghé, Quận 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

Worth a visit if you are in HCM city.

We are thrilled to hear that you enjoyed the fresh, well-presented food and our selection of beers, cocktails, and wines. We hope to welcome you back on your next trip to HCMC for another refreshing meal under the stars!

The Secret Garden Team

As for finding us—yes, part of our charm is being a little hidden gem! We appreciate your patience in locating us, and we hope the discovery was worth the adventure. Regarding the service pace, thank you for your understanding; we always aim to be attentive without rushing, so guests can relax and savor their meal, especially while on holiday.
We would be thrilled to welcome you back on your next visit to Ho Chi Minh City. Until then, safe travels and happy eating!
Warm regards,
The Secret Garden Team

contaminated staircase lead to the large roof terrace where the restaurant is located. If you have not made a reservation you will be placed at a communal table which can lead to nice meetings. 
The restaurant makes a “ lived-in” impression. Everything is still decorated as probably 30 years ago and has not been thoroughly cleaned since. 
About the food we can be brief: just very tasty and authentic Vietnamese. 
A special experience.

Beste Arnicdewinter,
Hartelijk dank voor uw mooie 4-sterren review en uw eerlijke beschrijving van uw bezoek aan Secret Garden Vietnamese Restaurant. Wij zijn erg blij te horen dat u onze locatie als een "bijzondere ervaring" heeft ervaren.
U heeft helemaal gelijk: de weg naar ons restaurant – door een donker steegje, langs scooters en via een trap van 8 verdiepingen – is inderdaad onverwacht en niet voor iedereen. Maar juist deze unieke toegang leidt naar ons groene dakterras, een oase van rust en sfeer boven de drukte van de stad. Wij waarderen uw opmerkingen over de "doorleefde" inrichting en de staat van het trappenhuis; wij streven ernaar de authentieke, nostalgische charme van onze locatie te behouden, terwijl wij tegelijkertijd blijven werken aan het verbeteren van de netheid en het comfort voor onze gasten.
Fijn om te horen dat u de gemeenschappelijke tafel als een leuke kans op nieuwe ontmoetingen heeft ervaren – het delen van een maaltijd met andere reizigers is inderdaad een van de mooie aspecten van ons restaurant. En natuurlijk zijn we vooral trots op uw compliment over het eten: authentiek Vietnamees, gewoon erg lekker. Dat is waar wij elke dag ons best voor doen.
We hopen u snel nog eens te mogen verwelkomen, misschien met een reservering voor een nog comfortabelere ervaring. Tot binnenkort!
Met vriendelijke groet,
Het Team van Secret Garden Vietnamese Restaurant

Một lần nữa, cảm ơn Quý khách đã tin tưởng lựa chọn The Lounge và chúng tôi mong sớm được đón tiếp quý khách vào một ngày gần nhất.

We had an unforgettable experience at Sole last night. Our bartenders, Danh and Jay, were incredibly friendly and welcoming, creating such a great atmosphere throughout the evening. If you're dining as a couple, we highly recommend sitting at the bar—it makes the experience even more special. The food was outstanding, and the cocktails were equally impressive. OMG the food is out of this world! Fair to say as a family we sampled just about every dish on the menu. If this word is offensive then it is simply not meant this way. Every mouthful was unctuous! For me it means rich, lush, and velvety. It describes a luxurious, fatty mouthfeel that coats the palate in a satisfying way, without feeling unpleasantly greasy. Chefs kiss!

We were walking by at lunchtime and noticed the sign for Sol, we had read about it so decided to try. We’re so happy we did! I had the duck empanada for starter, it was chock full of duck meat and the pastry was not too thick, not too thin. The sauce it came with had just the right amount of kick. BF had the beef taquitos, he also enjoyed them. I had sea bass tacos for main course and oh my goodness they were amazing! Big slabs of fish, perfectly cooked. I’m still thinking about them. BF had shrimp fajitas that looked fab. Lunch set menu was about USD 12 each for two courses (small surcharge for the shrimp). I also had an iced jasmine tea that the barman kindly tailored for me without the peach nectar, and BF had a margarita. Very good value for the size of the meals and quality of the ingredients. The restaurant had a very cool vibe too. We would have gone back if we hadn’t found it on our last day in HCMC.
Amazing Experience at Sol Kitchen & Bar – Wonderful Food, Tasty Drinks, and Brilliant Service

I had a wonderful experience dining at Sol Kitchen & Bar, and it exceeded my expectations in every way.
FOOD
The food here is great, and each dish that we ordered was extremely tasty, and beautifully made and presented. Portion sizes were generous without being too large, and it was satisfying. The even seasoning and balanced presentation shows a lot of care from the kitchen staff and chef. The food quality is a reason to come, regardless of it being a casual meal, or a celebration.

DRINKS
The drinks here are just as good as the food. The happy hour drinks are especially worth it. The cocktails are balanced, and refreshing, and happy hour makes it even better as we can try the cocktails without spending a lot of money.

SERVICE
In addition to the drinks and food, the service here is phenomenal. The staff was super friendly and created a welcoming space. They provided very good supportive services and made sure we were comfortable the whole time we were there.

The staff's friendly demeanor made the evening more enjoyable by bringing an additional personalized warmth to the evening. Overall, Sol Kitchen & Bar provides a complete dining experience — great food, amazing drinks, and top-notch service. It’s a place I would definitely go back to and would recommend to anyone who would like to have a wonderful dining experience in a relaxed and classy atmosphere.

Had the most wonderful meal at Sol’s Kitchen. Unbelievably delicious and generous serves. Rosie and Catherine were both amazing staff. 
Service, attentiveness, atmosphere and meals 10/10. 
Came twice whilst we were here in Saigon. Would highly recommend and can’t wait to come again.
A Masterclass in How Not to Run a Restaurant

I wanted to give this place a chance. I really did. But their complete incompetence at the most basic function of a restaurant, taking reservations, left me no choice but to warn everyone I know.

Let me paint the picture: I filled out their online reservation form. Nothing. Silence. So I filled it out again. Still nothing. Maybe the system was broken? I called. Once. Twice. Three times. Four times. Five times. Six times. Seven times. Each time, the phone rang into the void. No voicemail. No callback. Just dead air.

This isn't a minor inconvenience; this is a restaurant that apparently doesn't want customers. They've made it functionally impossible to give them money. How do you run an establishment in 2026 and not answer your phone or respond to reservation requests? It's not ambitious. It's not a style choice. It's negligence.

The only explanation is that this restaurant is staffed by people who either don't care or don't understand the fundamentals of hospitality. If they can't manage the front door, what does the kitchen look like?

Don't waste your time, energy, or optimism. There are dozens of restaurants in this city run by people who actually want your business. Go to any of them instead.

review_text: Take advantage of the lunch break to bring the guys in the office out here to change the scenery after several days of chasing KPIs at the end of the quarter. The price is a bit high compared to the usual lunch for office workers, but the location right in the Ben Thanh area can also be understood. restaurant_name: A Taste Of Saigon - Ben Thanh
review_text: Being almost 60 years old, I eat quite simply, usually preferring dishes with traditional flavors. On my trip to Saigon in early autumn, I was introduced by an acquaintance and came here to try pho. The pho bowl served was hot, the broth was clear and quite light, and the beef was moderately tender. Felix greeted me politely, and during the meal, he even asked if I liked the food. What I didn't like much was that the stairs to the restaurant are a bit steep, and elderly people will need to be careful when walking. As for the food, it suits my taste quite well.

restaurant_name: A Taste Of Saigon - Ben Thanh
review_text: On the weekend, the two of us went for a walk around Le Loi, watched the streets light up, and then stopped by a restaurant for a meal. From the busy street, stepping inside, the space is much cozier. Daisy is a cute server, and when we didn't know what to choose, she suggested bun cha and salted coffee. Fragrant grilled meat, seasoned just right, goes well with vegetables. It's a pity the side vegetables are a bit little, especially for someone who likes to eat a lot of vegetables like me. Overall, it's a decent option for a couple's evening stroll around the center.

review_text:
Easily one of the best in town. Walking in the restaurant to be hit by a strong meaty sweet basil aroma . Amazing quality beef 🥩 pho (noodle soup) served with fresh herbs 🌿 . Add a side serving of crunchy fried dough sticks to dunk in your soup. Freshly blended refreshing fruit juices .

review_text: Just get the hot stone with wagyu and oxtail

restaurant_name: Phở Việt Nam - Phạm Hồng Thái
review_text:
Location: facing a big road 250m (Google Map said so) from Ben Thanh Market.

Store: Original store still there, but they've a larger seating area two shops to the left. Renovated with AC which was good for hot and barmy Vietnam days.

Staff: Funny to hear Aussie twang from the few server guys, probably sons of owner? They love joking around with tourists!

Food: Just go for the top - hot stone with wagyu and oxtail, with those freshly made and cut rice noodles topped with a variety of fresh herbs, surprisingly nourishing even for hot days. Thank goodness they do have strong AC. They do have other cuts and combinations of meat - might be tougher, though.

Time: Cooking, serving, customer turnaround time is really fast. Probably because everything's so tender and easy to slurp up. Even if the place if full e.g. during peak, you won't have to wait for long for a seat.

Price: Reasonable.

restaurant_name: Phở Việt Nam - Phạm Hồng Thái
review_text: Omg. First night in Vietnam and this was exactly what be needed! Amazing food. So tasty. Great staff.

review_text: They could’ve done better. Disappointing

restaurant_name: Phở Việt Nam - Phạm Hồng Thái
review_text: They served the Pho cold or at least warm. Fortunately, I was sitting in front of the waitstaff and they saw that the soup is not hot enough to cook the leaves, noodles and meat. They took it back thinking that they will replace a new and hot one but after waiting for a while, they returned the same bowl which is boiling with the noodles and the meats in it. Noodles became so saggy that it got melted and soup almost got absorbed. They could have just done it much better. If only I knew, I should’ve stopped them from boiling the same soup with the noodles and beef in it. Soup tasted still good but everything is not good. Super chewy beef and noodles almost became a porridge. A small cockroach is walking around my table good thing I noticed after I finished with the meat. Can’t attach vids of the cockroach.

restaurant_name: Phở Việt Nam - Phạm Hồng Thái
review_text:
Phở Việt Nam is something special. Open around the clock, and for good reason — we went twice in two days and would have gone back a third time without hesitation.

The pho is made continuously, and you can watch them slice the chicken breast directly off the bone as they prepare your bowl. The result is the most tender chicken I have ever had in a bowl of pho — impossibly silky and fresh. My husband, a chicken pho first-timer, was completely won over. The second visit was every bit as good as the first — consistent, generous, and deeply satisfying.

If you're in Ho Chi Minh City, don't walk past this one. At any hour.

review_text: We all got small pho and it was a good quite large sized portion very happy with it. Service was very attentive and made it a fun experience however I wouldn’t get the lemonade as they use tap water in it.

Returning to ANAN Saigon - @anansaigon - after a year, I was struck by how the restaurant continues to master the delicate art of evolution without alienation. Nestled within the gritty, pulsating heart of the Chợ Cũ market, the iconic “tube house” setting remains a masterclass in atmospheric contrast—a polished, vibrant sanctuary that feels entirely at home amidst the city’s chaotic energy.

@petercuongfranklin Chef Peter Cuong Franklin’s “Cuisine Mới” philosophy is on full display here. What remains most impressive is the unwavering consistency in his vision: an ability to deconstruct and elevate the soul of Vietnamese street culture through a sophisticated, refined lens. Every course is a testament to his deep respect for local roots, where the heritage of the flavors is never lost, even as they are reimagined through modern technique.

The service is warm, knowledgeable, and distinctly convivial, mirroring the unpretentious spirit of Saigon itself. It is a rare, high-octane dining experience that manages to be both intellectually stimulating and deeply comforting. 

ANAN remains a vital pulse in Vietnam’s gastronomic scene, proving that true culinary innovation is about honoring the past with every forward-thinking bite. A triumphant return.

⭐️ CONFIRMED IN THE Y&SFOOD! SAIGON DINING GUIDE 2026.

We dined last weekend at Anan Saigon, and it completely blew us away. Nestled right in the vibrant heart of the Ton That Dam Street market, Chef Peter Cuong Franklin’s one-Michelin-star gem is a brilliant beacon of "Cuisine Mới" (modern Vietnamese cuisine).

We treated ourselves to the "Culinary Journey Through Vietnam" tasting menu, and every single dish was a masterpiece. We loved how the chef paired elegance and textures in the "Foie Gras Spring Roll," while the whimsical "Le Petit Bánh Mì" was pure genius. The absolute highlight for us was the "Caviar Box Đà Lạt"—we’ve never had caviar served as a dessert before, yet this was in the pure tradition of sweet / salted Vietnamese savours. "Strangely delicious" 😋 

Beautifully focused lighting that made our plates look stunning. Combined with flawless service and multiple table visits from the friendly chef, Anan is easily one of our favorite restaurants in Asia!

Food was absolutely bust me down good. Unique and incredibly flavorful, I felt like I was having a religious experience with each bite. The low lighting and soft music made the atmosphere feel intimate, cozy—-a delicious retreat from the never ending sound that pours from the street. The bartender with the glasses and piercings was very sweet, and the drinks were also absolutely amazing. Everyone was very kind, accommodating and ensured our stomachs, hearts, and tastebuds were happy.

I chose this restaurant after reading the excellent reviews and hearing about famous visitors who had eaten here.

Unfortunately, my wife and I had a completely different experience. From the moment we arrived, I felt extremely uncomfortable and unwelcome. I felt that we were receiving hostile looks from some staff and other people in the restaurant, and the atmosphere made both of us very uneasy.

I became uncomfortable enough that I decided we should leave immediately. I genuinely felt unsafe, which is something I have rarely experienced while travelling.

This is simply my personal experience of our visit, but it was unpleasant enough that I would not return or recommend the restaurant based on what happened to us.

First, I had the banana flower salad with chicken. It was fresh, and the vegetables were thinly sliced. The dressing was savory and gave the dish a bright, refreshing flavor. I felt that all the ingredients worked harmoniously together, and the combination of textures made it enjoyable to eat. Next, I tried the prawn stewed in a claypot with starfruit. This was a comforting, home-style dish that really captured the essence of Vietnamese home cooking. The prawns were firm and juicy, while the sauce was rich, flavorful, and well-balanced. The starfruit blended naturally into the sauce. Overall, it was a very satisfying dish. Lastly, I had the lá lốt wrapped beef. Unfortunately, this was the weakest dish of the meal. The beef was overcooked, making it less tender than it should have been. It was also under-seasoned, so without the accompanying dipping sauce, it tasted bland. However, what disappointed me the most was the service. One of the dishes I ordered, sương sâm, was never served. I waited for 30 minutes before deciding to pay the bill and leave. I was surprised that a restaurant with so many staff members could overlook such a basic part of the dining experience.

Everything is PERFECT: what is on the plate, the setting, the background music, the staff. Go there without hesitation; you will not be disappointed if you love Vietnamese cuisine; you will be in the right place. Fair price

The food was plentiful and enjoyable, with generous portions that make it great for sharing. Service was also a standout, attentive, friendly, and efficient without being overbearing.

The only surprise was the additional charges at the end of the meal. Alongside a 10% fee, there was an extra 8% tax that wasn’t clearly explained, which was a bit confusing.

Overall, it’s a lovely spot with great food, excellent service, and a warm atmosphere, just worth being aware of the extra charges when you dine.

We had the shrimp salad, the clay pot pork, the clay pot shrimp, steak pho, salt and pepper soft shell crab, sour soup, and yogurt for dessert. Everything was absolutely delicious. We loved it all, especially the pork! The atmosphere was beautiful and it was overall a fantastic dinner!

We went with a local who grew up in the neighborhood. His parents eat here four times a week and I see why. Huge menu so we let him guide us. I was a bit dubious about the lemon tofu, “best in Saigon” but he was right. Brad and Angelina found it and so should you.
Retry but disappointed again. Tiny plates and became to expensive

First times came here around 2012 (when they just open), food was good. We have been here many times when we are in Vietnam. Years by years the restaurant is downgrade, food just ok, portions extremely small compared with before and prices are increased too much and no local people come here anymore, only foreigners. We decided to not come back here anymore but this time we are with nany friends and booking for "quan Bui" (our favourite restaurant) but pity that it is fully booked. We said retry cuc gach quan and see if they improved, but not, worst, only foreigners in the restaurant. 1 portions of chicken I can count 4 or 5 mini very mini pieces. Squid with fish sauce, but rarely see squid as there are only few pieces mixed with almost onion, maby they should call thus plate is onion with squid decorated. Other foods are so tiny as well. This restaurant became Too expensive. If talking about design of the restaurant, there are so many many restaurants and coffee shops are very beautiful in Saigon, designed like a old Vietnamese house too.
A Vietnamese restaurant with a homely feel that happened to make great food

It was a great find in what I would consider up the main road. The restaurant was set up like a traditional Vietnamese family home with great wooden features, a fish, pond, stocking Koi and catfish outfront and meal served in what I would expect to see in a regular house. The meals were presented well and paid homage to the cooking of the Vietnamese. It was a great family or friend environment. The only point I like to mention is that some of the steps into the establishment and within the establishment are quite high and people in wheelchairs or have a walking impairment may struggle but these too can be worked around.

Very Local foods. Big menu. Lots of choices for foods from the north & south of Việt Nam 
Beautiful decoration. God foods.

Really nice food and good service. We got good help in ordering dishes as we are not so experienced in the Vietnamese cuisine. 
Prices were reasonable. 
We sat next to a company (they weren’t unusually loud) and it was often difficult to have a conversation. Maybe something could be done about the acoustics in the room.
But again. Really nice food and friendly and helpful service that spoke good English.

The house in which the restaurant is located is very interesting, with some funny architecture inside (you can look around while you wait). 
The menu is very extensive, you need to know what you want or ask someone to advise you. The food itself is good though not exceptionnal.

Great Taste of Vietnam in Saigon

We found this location on Trip advisor, while it was difficult for the driver to locate the address on the side street the warmth and service from this restaurant made it all worthwhile. 

Old history and great vibe in different small areas of the restaurant. We received great recommendations from the waiter for dishes to share. 

The soup, beef rolls, spring rolls and the soft shell crab were all excellent. We also enjoyed seafood fried rice and pork and egg in clay pot. 

We will come back to this little gem
Good food and service, totally recommended....very friendly......we repeat three times and everything very well.........do not hesitate

review_text:
Bếp Mẹ Ỉn xin gửi lời cảm ơn chân thành đến quý khách đã dành lời khen cho Bếp ạ!

Bếp rất vui khi mình đã để lại ấn tượng tốt đẹp với quý khách bởi các món ăn và chất lượng phục vụ. Bếp Mẹ Ỉn luôn nỗ lực để xây dựng một thực đơn đa dạng đi cùng với chất lượng và giá cả hợp lý, đồng thời phát triển một đội ngũ nhân viên chuyên nghiệp, thân thiện và tận tâm, vì vậy lời khen của quý khách là một nguồn động viên rất lớn cho Bếp Mẹ Ỉn.

Hy vọng quý khách sẽ tiếp tục ủng hộ Bếp Mẹ Ỉn và có thêm nhiều trải nghiệm tuyệt vời tại nhà hàng.

Delightful, friendly service from Nam - highly recommended the Rooty Bar.

We had such an amazing experience thanks to Tan at the rooftop bar. He truly made our trip extra special. He was professional, attentive, incredibly kind, and went far above and beyond.

Tan gave us excellent menu recommendations and shared local places we should try while visiting. When we mentioned how sad we were that we hadn’t been able to find fresh green mangoes and our hotel didn’t have them on the menu, he actually helped us order them, communicated with the delivery driver for us, and made sure we got exactly what we were craving.

The rooftop bar itself is absolutely beautiful — the night swim with the glowing blue lights, the lights in the trees, and the stunning river views created the perfect atmosphere. But what truly elevated the experience was the exceptional hospitality.

His warmth, helpfulness, and genuine care turned a small moment into one of our favorite memories from this trip. Service like this is exactly why we returned again this year, and Tan is absolutely one of the reasons we would come back again. Thank you, Tan, for making our stay so memorable!

Banana Mama Rooftop & Kitchen is hands-down one of the best nights out in Saigon. Ride the elevator up to the 10th floor of the WMC Tower and you land in a beachy, plant-filled rooftop with jaw-dropping skyline views, especially at sunset. Staff are warm and attentive, the vibes are chill and fun. The whole experience feels like a mini beach-club escape without ever leaving District 1. If you’re ever in HCMC, this place absolutely has to be on your list.

Had such a lovely stay at Banana Mama Vietnam with my friends! The staff were incredibly welcoming, the atmosphere was so fun and relaxed, and everything was clean and well organised. It was the perfect place to meet people and explore Ho Chi Minh City. We’d definitely stay here again! 🍌⭐

Returning to ANAN Saigon - @anansaigon - after a year, I was struck by how the restaurant continues to master the delicate art of evolution without alienation. Nestled within the gritty, pulsating heart of the Chợ Cũ market, the iconic “tube house” setting remains a masterclass in atmospheric contrast—a polished, vibrant sanctuary that feels entirely at home amidst the city’s chaotic energy.

@petercuongfranklin Chef Peter Cuong Franklin’s “Cuisine Mới” philosophy is on full display here. What remains most impressive is the unwavering consistency in his vision: an ability to deconstruct and elevate the soul of Vietnamese street culture through a sophisticated, refined lens. Every course is a testament to his deep respect for local roots, where the heritage of the flavors is never lost, even as they are reimagined through modern technique.

The service is warm, knowledgeable, and distinctly convivial, mirroring the unpretentious spirit of Saigon itself. It is a rare, high-octane dining experience that manages to be both intellectually stimulating and deeply comforting. 

ANAN remains a vital pulse in Vietnam’s gastronomic scene, proving that true culinary innovation is about honoring the past with every forward-thinking bite. A triumphant return.

⭐️ CONFIRMED IN THE Y&SFOOD! SAIGON DINING GUIDE 2026.

We dined last weekend at Anan Saigon, and it completely blew us away. Nestled right in the vibrant heart of the Ton That Dam Street market, Chef Peter Cuong Franklin’s one-Michelin-star gem is a brilliant beacon of "Cuisine Mới" (modern Vietnamese cuisine).

We treated ourselves to the "Culinary Journey Through Vietnam" tasting menu, and every single dish was a masterpiece. We loved how the chef paired elegance and textures in the "Foie Gras Spring Roll," while the whimsical "Le Petit Bánh Mì" was pure genius. The absolute highlight for us was the "Caviar Box Đà Lạt"—we’ve never had caviar served as a dessert before, yet this was in the pure tradition of sweet / salted Vietnamese savours. "Strangely delicious" 😋 

Beautifully focused lighting that made our plates look stunning. Combined with flawless service and multiple table visits from the friendly chef, Anan is easily one of our favorite restaurants in Asia!

Food was absolutely bust me down good. Unique and incredibly flavorful, I felt like I was having a religious experience with each bite. The low lighting and soft music made the atmosphere feel intimate, cozy—-a delicious retreat from the never ending sound that pours from the street. The bartender with the glasses and piercings was very sweet, and the drinks were also absolutely amazing. Everyone was very kind, accommodating and ensured our stomachs, hearts, and tastebuds were happy.

What a wonderful place for High Tea! Stunning City views from Level 48 of the Iconic Landmark 81. We booked a 3:30pm time slot on purpose to enjoy the carefully crafted Vietnamese style Afternoon Tea with bottomless tea and coffee. Each of the delectable morsels hand crafted by expert chefs was a delight to behold. One thing of note was the unusual ratio of savoury to sweet with the majority of our fare being savoury. This particularly pleased my Chef wife who prefers savoury to sweet. We finished in time to witness a burning red sunset over the Saigon skyline sipping some exquisite liqueur patiently awaiting the light show of buildings to ignite the evening sky. Our waitress for the afternoon and evening, Bella, performed her duties inexplicably. In fact all of the staff were very attentive and respectful and thanked us in person when leaving which we both thought was a lovely touch.

Window view looking over the city, unfortunately outside was closed but was still a good view.

Staff is amazing, we had one that had pretty good English so that made it easier for us. 

Chill vibes, very soul setting.

Food was 10/10!

restaurant_name: A Taste Of Saigon - Ben Thanh
review_text: We came with friends and ordered different dishes so everyone could taste something. The bún chả, seafood and vegetarian options gave us plenty of variety. The staff kept the atmosphere cheerful and were quick whenever we needed anything.

restaurant_name: A Taste Of Saigon - Ben Thanh
review_text: Take advantage of the lunch break to bring the guys in the office out here to change the scenery after several days of chasing KPIs at the end of the quarter. The restaurant serves food quite quickly, about 7-10 minutes for most dishes to be ready, and they are still hot when served. I ordered rare beef pho, with a rich broth, and some crispy fried dough sticks went well with it. The price is a bit high compared to the usual lunch for office workers, but the location right in the Ben Thanh area can also be understood. Kaiden helps our group split bills quickly, which is quite convenient when there are many people.

restaurant_name: A Taste Of Saigon - Ben Thanh
review_text: Traditional pho flavor in the heart of the city

restaurant_name: A Taste Of Saigon - Ben Thanh
review_text: Being almost 60 years old, I eat quite simply, usually preferring dishes with traditional flavors. On my trip to Saigon in early autumn, I was introduced by an acquaintance and came here to try pho. The pho bowl served was hot, the broth was clear and quite light, and the beef was moderately tender. Felix greeted me politely, and during the meal, he even asked if I liked the food. What I didn't like much was that the stairs to the restaurant are a bit steep, and elderly people will need to be careful when walking. As for the food, it suits my taste quite well.

restaurant_name: A Taste Of Saigon - Ben Thanh
review_text: On the weekend, the two of us went for a walk around Le Loi, watched the streets light up, and then stopped by a restaurant for a meal. From the busy street, stepping inside, the space is much cozier. Daisy is a cute server, and when we didn't know what to choose, she suggested bun cha and salted coffee. Fragrant grilled meat, seasoned just right, goes well with vegetables. It's a pity the side vegetables are a bit little, especially for someone who likes to eat a lot of vegetables like me. Overall, it's a decent option for a couple's evening stroll around the center.

I celebrated my birthday alone at Oriental Pearl Restaurant this Monday and I honestly didn’t expect the team to make it feel so special. Even though I booked quite late, everyone was very supportive and welcoming.

The staff even sang Happy Birthday and surprised me with a cake, which was such a sweet moment. I’ll probably never forget this birthday. Special thanks to Mr. Tan, Ms. Amy, and Ms. Phuong and all the staff who were there that day for the wonderful service. 🥺🥺🫶🏼

Sated Coffee was also really good btw :))

The restaurant is very popular among travelers, but it turns out they only welcome well-known or returning guests, showing clear discrimination toward new visitors. There’s no option to choose a window-side table when I reserved. I made an early reservation specifically to get a spot with a nice view, but the restaurant messaged me saying, “We’re sorry, the window-side tables are fully booked as they’ve already been reserved. "??. It turned out there was no window-view table available for us because they were all reserved, which didn’t make any sense to me. Just save a great table for your favorite guests. I won’t be coming back to this restaurant. I don’t eat for free. Thanks for taking the time to read this.

Horrible is the only word that fits: at the bottom of a dark courtyard where dozens of motorcycles are parked, you have to climb 4 awful floors on foot because the elevator is condemned by chains and padlocks. After twenty minutes, I get up and go check with a waiter to finally take our order (other people entered after us had already been able to place an order.)

We study the short dessert menu... then wait. Nobody's coming. We ended up getting paid and leaving. Don’t waste your time, breath and money: go your way.

Special restaurant in a place you don't expect. First through dark alley with scooters and then up 8 flights of stairs 
contaminated staircase lead to the large roof terrace where the restaurant is located. If you have not made a reservation you will be placed at a communal table which can lead to nice meetings. 
The restaurant makes a “ lived-in” impression. Everything is still decorated as probably 30 years ago and has not been thoroughly cleaned since. 
About the food we can be brief: just very tasty and authentic Vietnamese.

Beste Arnicdewinter,
Hartelijk dank voor uw mooie 4-sterren review en uw eerlijke beschrijving van uw bezoek aan Secret Garden Vietnamese Restaurant. Wij zijn erg blij te horen dat u onze locatie als een "bijzondere ervaring" heeft ervaren.
U heeft helemaal gelijk: de weg naar ons restaurant – door een donker steegje, langs scooters en via een trap van 8 verdiepingen – is inderdaad onverwacht en niet voor iedereen. Maar juist deze unieke toegang leidt naar ons groene dakterras, een oase van rust en sfeer boven de drukte van de stad. Fijn om te horen dat u de gemeenschappelijke tafel als een leuke kans op nieuwe ontmoetingen heeft ervaren – het delen van een maaltijd met andere reizigers is inderdaad een van de mooie aspecten van ons restaurant. En natuurlijk zijn we vooral trots op uw compliment over het eten: authentiek Vietnamees, gewoon erg lekker. Dat is waar wij elke dag ons best voor doen.
We hopen u snel nog eens te mogen verwelkomen, misschien met een reservering voor een nog comfortabelere ervaring. Tot binnenkort!
Met vriendelijke groet,

review_text: I had a wonderful experience at De Tham Restaurant

restaurant_name: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese Cuisine & Vegetarian Food
review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I had a wonderful experience at De Tham Restaurant, and I especially want to recognize my server, Anna. She was extremely polite, patient, attentive, and genuinely helpful throughout my meal.

What impressed me most was her initiative. I’m visiting Vietnam and still learning how some Vietnamese dishes are traditionally eaten. Anna didn’t just bring my food and walk away. She took the time to come over, help cut the pork for me, and explain how to eat it with the rice paper. When I thought I needed to dip the rice paper in water, she patiently explained that it was already soft and ready to use.

Those may seem like small things, but when you’re a visitor experiencing unfamiliar food, that kind of patience and hospitality makes a big difference. I never felt rushed or uncomfortable asking questions.

The food was delicious, but Anna’s service made the experience even better. She was warm, professional, patient, and attentive without being overbearing. Thank you, Anna, for making my meal such an enjoyable experience. I would gladly come back again. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

The siu mai in particular was utterly divine: meaty, satisfying and absolutely delicious. Other must eats include the mustard and mayo prawns, the beef in black pepper sauce, and the charcoal prawn and chive dim sum.
You MUST visit this place. Exceptional value and fantastic quality. I would absolutely eat here again.

Tge ban people is a Vietnamese specialty and we had the regular sized one wich was huge. 
It was tasty with large prawns, pork and bean sprouts. The Vietnamese restaurants often give you a huge bowl of salad with a great variety of leaves including herbs that are great for you. Very friendly servers and felt a bit sorry for the chefs working in the heat over the woks with charcoal burners under them. 
Not a push air con place but very authentic and typical super friendly Vietnamese people to go with tasty food.
BÁNH XÈO 46A. Is it worth the hype? Nah!

Nice mom and pop place. No frills. Find someone to check in with, they'll get you seated. We didn't have much of a wait and got 2 orders of banh xeo and one order of goi cuon (10 rolls). Plenty veggies but we asked for more lettuce as we love the greens. They were quick and efficient. Banh xeo was good, probably could've ordered one more for the 4 of us but we were headed to a brewery afterwards. There are 5-6 adorable gray poodles that live in this place, sitting obediently on the gated stairway watching everyone. Being a huge animal lover, this was fine by me. They were well groomed and we were able to pet them.

We read great reviews of this place in a local guidebook, but overall not impressed. Upon arrival, we felt that the environment was not friendly to tourists. We sat down and the cutlery, bowls and table were unclean. Took a while to get served and the food was quite bland. Perhaps a hidden gem a few years ago but certainly wouldn’t recommend.

Extremely Unpleasant Frightening Experience

Horrible, frightening experience

I chose this restaurant after reading the excellent reviews and hearing about famous visitors who had eaten here.

Unfortunately, my wife and I had a completely different experience. From the moment we arrived, I felt extremely uncomfortable and unwelcome. I felt that we were receiving hostile looks from some staff and other people in the restaurant, and the atmosphere made both of us very uneasy.

I became uncomfortable enough that I decided we should leave immediately. I genuinely felt unsafe, which is something I have rarely experienced while travelling.

This is simply my personal experience of our visit, but it was unpleasant enough that I would not return or recommend the restaurant based on what happened to us.

First, I had the banana flower salad with chicken. It was fresh, and the vegetables were thinly sliced. The dressing was savory and gave the dish a bright, refreshing flavor. I felt that all the ingredients worked harmoniously together, and the combination of textures made it enjoyable to eat. Next, I tried the prawn stewed in a claypot with starfruit. This was a comforting, home-style dish that really captured the essence of Vietnamese home cooking. The prawns were firm and juicy, while the sauce was rich, flavorful, and well-balanced. The starfruit blended naturally into the sauce. Overall, it was a very satisfying dish. Lastly, I had the lá lốt wrapped beef. Unfortunately, this was the weakest dish of the meal. The beef was overcooked, making it less tender than it should have been. It was also under-seasoned, so without the accompanying dipping sauce, it tasted bland. However, what disappointed me the most was the service. One of the dishes I ordered, sương sâm, was never served. I waited for 30 minutes before deciding to pay the bill and leave. I was surprised that a restaurant with so many staff members could overlook such a basic part of the dining experience.

Everything is PERFECT: what is on the plate, the setting, the background music, the staff. Go there without hesitation; you will not be disappointed if you love Vietnamese cuisine; you will be in the right place. Fair price
Cosy Atmosphere, Great Food! Just Watch the Extra Charges

Cuc Gach Quan offers a beautifully cosy and homely dining experience, with an atmosphere that immediately makes you feel comfortable and relaxed. The interior has a charming, lived-in feel that adds to the authenticity of the restaurant.

The food was plentiful and enjoyable, with generous portions that make it great for sharing. Service was also a standout, attentive, friendly, and efficient without being overbearing.

The only surprise was the additional charges at the end of the meal. Alongside a 10% fee, there was an extra 8% tax that wasn’t clearly explained, which was a bit confusing.

Overall, it’s a lovely spot with great food, excellent service, and a warm atmosphere, just worth being aware of the extra charges when you dine.

We had the shrimp salad, the clay pot pork, the clay pot shrimp, steak pho, salt and pepper soft shell crab, sour soup, and yogurt for dessert. Everything was absolutely delicious. We loved it all, especially the pork! The atmosphere was beautiful and it was overall a fantastic dinner!

We went with a local who grew up in the neighborhood. His parents eat here four times a week and I see why. Huge menu so we let him guide us. I was a bit dubious about the lemon tofu, “best in Saigon” but he was right. Brad and Angelina found it and so should you.
Retry but disappointed again. Tiny plates and became to expensive

First times came here around 2012 (when they just open), food was good. We have been here many times when we are in Vietnam. Years by years the restaurant is downgrade, food just ok, portions extremely small compared with before and prices are increased too much and no local people come here anymore, only foreigners. We decided to not come back here anymore but this time we are with nany friends and booking for "quan Bui" (our favourite restaurant) but pity that it is fully booked. We said retry cuc gach quan and see if they improved, but not, worst, only foreigners in the restaurant. 1 portions of chicken I can count 4 or 5 mini very mini pieces. Squid with fish sauce, but rarely see squid as there are only few pieces mixed with almost onion, maby they should call thus plate is onion with squid decorated. Other foods are so tiny as well. This restaurant became Too expensive. If talking about design of the restaurant, there are so many many restaurants and coffee shops are very beautiful in Saigon, designed like a old Vietnamese house too.
A Vietnamese restaurant with a homely feel that happened to make great food

It was a great find in what I would consider up the main road. The restaurant was set up like a traditional Vietnamese family home with great wooden features, a fish, pond, stocking Koi and catfish outfront and meal served in what I would expect to see in a regular house. The meals were presented well and paid homage to the cooking of the Vietnamese. It was a great family or friend environment. The only point I like to mention is that some of the steps into the establishment and within the establishment are quite high and people in wheelchairs or have a walking impairment may struggle but these too can be worked around.

Very Local foods. Big menu. Lots of choices for foods from the north & south of Việt Nam 
Beautiful decoration. God foods.

Really nice food and good service. We got good help in ordering dishes as we are not so experienced in the Vietnamese cuisine. 
Prices were reasonable. 
We sat next to a company (they weren’t unusually loud) and it was often difficult to have a conversation. Maybe something could be done about the acoustics in the room.
But again. Really nice food and friendly and helpful service that spoke good English.

The house in which the restaurant is located is very interesting, with some funny architecture inside (you can look around while you wait). 
The menu is very extensive, you need to know what you want or ask someone to advise you. The food itself is good though not exceptionnal.

Great Taste of Vietnam in Saigon

We found this location on Trip advisor, while it was difficult for the driver to locate the address on the side street the warmth and service from this restaurant made it all worthwhile. 

Old history and great vibe in different small areas of the restaurant. We received great recommendations from the waiter for dishes to share. 

The soup, beef rolls, spring rolls and the soft shell crab were all excellent. We also enjoyed seafood fried rice and pork and egg in clay pot. 

We will come back to this little gem
Good food and service, totally recommended....very friendly......we repeat three times and everything very well.........do not hesitate

review_text: Just get the hot stone with wagyu and oxtail

restaurant_name: Phở Việt Nam - Phạm Hồng Thái
review_text:
Location: facing a big road 250m (Google Map said so) from Ben Thanh Market.

Store: Original store still there, but they've a larger seating area two shops to the left. Renovated with AC which was good for hot and barmy Vietnam days.

Staff: Funny to hear Aussie twang from the few server guys, probably sons of owner? They love joking around with tourists!

Food: Just go for the top - hot stone with wagyu and oxtail, with those freshly made and cut rice noodles topped with a variety of fresh herbs, surprisingly nourishing even for hot days. Thank goodness they do have strong AC. They do have other cuts and combinations of meat - might be tougher, though.

Time: Cooking, serving, customer turnaround time is really fast. Probably because everything's so tender and easy to slurp up. Even if the place if full e.g. during peak, you won't have to wait for long for a seat.

Price: Reasonable.

restaurant_name: Phở Việt Nam - Phạm Hồng Thái
review_text: They served the Pho cold or at least warm. Fortunately, I was sitting in front of the waitstaff and they saw that the soup is not hot enough to cook the leaves, noodles and meat. They took it back thinking that they will replace a new and hot one but after waiting for a while, they returned the same bowl which is boiling with the noodles and the meats in it. Noodles became so saggy that it got melted and soup almost got absorbed. They could have just done it much better. If only I knew, I should’ve stopped them from boiling the same soup with the noodles and beef in it. Soup tasted still good but everything is not good. Super chewy beef and noodles almost became a porridge. A small cockroach is walking around my table good thing I noticed after I finished with the meat. Can’t attach vids of the cockroach.

restaurant_name: Phở Việt Nam - Phạm Hồng Thái
review_text:
Phở Việt Nam is something special. Open around the clock, and for good reason — we went twice in two days and would have gone back a third time without hesitation.

The pho is made continuously, and you can watch them slice the chicken breast directly off the bone as they prepare your bowl. The result is the most tender chicken I have ever had in a bowl of pho — impossibly silky and fresh. My husband, a chicken pho first-timer, was completely won over. The second visit was every bit as good as the first — consistent, generous, and deeply satisfying.

If you're in Ho Chi Minh City, don't walk past this one. At any hour.

We had an unforgettable experience at Sole last night. Our bartenders, Danh and Jay, were incredibly friendly and welcoming, creating such a great atmosphere throughout the evening. If you're dining as a couple, we highly recommend sitting at the bar—it makes the experience even more special. The food was outstanding, and the cocktails were equally impressive. We were walking by at lunchtime and noticed the sign for Sol, we had read about it so decided to try. We’re so happy we did! I had the duck empanada for starter, it was chock full of duck meat and the pastry was not too thick, not too thin. The sauce it came with had just the right amount of kick. BF had the beef taquitos, he also enjoyed them. I had sea bass tacos for main course and oh my goodness they were amazing! Big slabs of fish, perfectly cooked. I’m still thinking about them. Amazing Experience at Sol Kitchen & Bar – Wonderful Food, Tasty Drinks, and Brilliant Service

I had a wonderful experience dining at Sol Kitchen & Bar, and it exceeded my expectations in every way.
FOOD
The food here is great, and each dish that we ordered was extremely tasty, and beautifully made and presented. Portion sizes were generous without being too large, and it was satisfying. The even seasoning and balanced presentation shows a lot of care from the kitchen staff and chef. The food quality is a reason to come, regardless of it being a casual meal, or a celebration.

DRINKS
The drinks here are just as good as the food. The happy hour drinks are especially worth it. The cocktails are balanced, and refreshing, and happy hour makes it even better as we can try the cocktails without spending a lot of money.

SERVICE
In addition to the drinks and food, the service here is phenomenal. The staff was super friendly and created a welcoming space. They provided very good supportive services and made sure we were comfortable the whole time we were there.

The staff's friendly demeanor made the evening more enjoyable by bringing an additional personalized warmth to the evening. Overall, Sol Kitchen & Bar provides a complete dining experience — great food, amazing drinks, and top-notch service. It’s a place I would definitely go back to and would recommend to anyone who would like to have a wonderful dining experience in a relaxed and classy atmosphere.

Had the most wonderful meal at Sol’s Kitchen. Unbelievably delicious and generous serves. Rosie and Catherine were both amazing staff. 
Service, attentiveness, atmosphere and meals 10/10. 
Came twice whilst we were here in Saigon. Would highly recommend and can’t wait to come again.
A Masterclass in How Not to Run a Restaurant

I wanted to give this place a chance. I really did. But their complete incompetence at the most basic function of a restaurant, taking reservations, left me no choice but to warn everyone I know.

Let me paint the picture: I filled out their online reservation form. Nothing. Silence. So I filled it out again. Still nothing. Maybe the system was broken? I called. Once. Twice. Three times. Four times. Five times. Six times. Seven times. Each time, the phone rang into the void. No voicemail. No callback. Just dead air.

This isn't a minor inconvenience; this is a restaurant that apparently doesn't want customers. They've made it functionally impossible to give them money. What a wonderful place for High Tea! Stunning City views from Level 48 of the Iconic Landmark 81. We booked a 3:30pm time slot on purpose to enjoy the carefully crafted Vietnamese style Afternoon Tea with bottomless tea and coffee. Each of the delectable morsels hand crafted by expert chefs was a delight to behold. One thing of note was the unusual ratio of savoury to sweet with the majority of our fare being savoury. This particularly pleased my Chef wife who prefers savoury to sweet. We finished in time to witness a burning red sunset over the Saigon skyline sipping some exquisite liqueur patiently awaiting the light show of buildings to ignite the evening sky. Our waitress for the afternoon and evening, Bella, performed her duties inexplicably. In fact all of the staff were very attentive and respectful and thanked us in person when leaving which we both thought was a lovely touch.

Window view looking over the city, unfortunately outside was closed but was still a good view.

Staff is amazing, we had one that had pretty good English so that made it easier for us. 

Chill vibes, very soul setting.

Food was 10/10! 
Good value for money!
Superb food, great view and fantastic staff!

Myself and my husband are in Ho Chi Minh City to celebrate my birthday and our silver wedding anniversary, we booked The Cloud for our evening meal which was superb. The staff are so attentive, friendly and welcoming and they couldn’t do enough for us. Once they knew it was my birthday they made me feel so special with a cocktail, coffee with a birthday cake design on it and dressed our desserts with birthday wishes and a candle. The view whilst we were eating was amazing!!! I would definitely recommend this restaurant.

We had a wonderful experience at The Cloud Bar. The staff was courteous and professional, especially our server, Daria. Daria was very knowledgeable in recommending the appropriate wine for our group. The food and drinks were excellent and the service was top notch. We will definitely be back and would recommend The Cloud Bar to our family and friends.

The view was absolutely stunning and the vibes were immaculate. The managers Tan and Trang welcomed us right away, and made our time there wonderful. The servers Phuc and Joy took care of our table without being intrusive, which I really appreciated. The whole experience felt relaxing and well put together. The food was delicious, and the staff were so friendly. I’d recommend The Cloud to anyone visiting Landmark 81.

Forget the "sterile and boring" hotel bar stereotype—Barson has major main character energy. It's a really unusual for a hotel bar in Marriott.

The crowd is actually fun to chat with, and the cocktails are these really innovative drinks inspired by Vietnam itself. Julie, Anna, and Dino are total legends—they’re so hospitable and easy to talk to that you'll forget you're technically a tourist. If you’re in Ho Chi Minh City and want a drink that doesn't taste like a mid-life crisis, stop by here. I’m definitely going back.

Hi W7290AQdavidl

Thank you so much for such a vibrant and honest take on your experience at BARSON.

We love that you felt the energy we aim to create something far from the usual hotel bar scene, where conversations flow as easily as the cocktails. It’s especially great to hear that our Vietnam-inspired creations stood out and added to your night.

Julie, Anna, and Dino will be absolutely thrilled to read your kind words. 

We’re so glad you found your spot with us in Ho Chi Minh City, and we’ll be here whenever you’re ready for your next round.

Warm regards,

Barson has become one of my all-time favorite places to enjoy. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, making it the perfect spot to relax after a long day. The staff are incredibly friendly, they always greet you with a smile and make you feel welcome. Thanks for make my day: Sang, Dino, Jayce, Viktor, Tien !!!
The drinks are consistently great, with a good variety to choose from, and the bartenders really know their craft. Whether you're in the mood for a classic cocktail or something new, they never disappoint.
What makes this place even more special right now is the cozy Christmas Decor. The warm lights, festive ornaments, and subtle holiday touches create such a comforting, joyful vibe. It feels like stepping into a little holiday escape - perfect for enjoying good drinks and good company.
Highly recommended for anyone lookin laid-back bar with great service ❤️❤️❤️

Dear Getaway62244282487,

Sang, Dino, Jayce, Viktor, and Tiến were all over the moon when we shared your kind words with them. Your appreciation truly fuels their passion to keep creating a space where guests can feel genuinely welcomed and well taken care of.

We’re thrilled that you’re enjoying not only the drinks but also the festive atmosphere we’ve brought in for the season. Christmas in BARSON is all about warmth, comfort, and just a touch of sparkle. That’s exactly what we hoped to create.

You’ll always have a seat waiting for you here, whether you’re chasing classics or ready to try something new from our cocktail lineup. 

Warmest wishes this festive season,

We visited 4P’s Pizza at D1Mension Residences, and the food was absolutely awesome and delicious. Unfortunately, there were a couple of things that took away from an otherwise enjoyable dining experience.

While serving the dishes, the staff held the food in their hands while explaining the dishes to us from very close range. Because they were speaking so close to the food, I was concerned about saliva droplets potentially reaching the dishes. I found this quite unpleasant and felt that it could be handled in a more hygienic way.

The toilet was another disappointment. It was quite smelly and did not appear to be very clean or well maintained, which was surprising given the restaurant's overall standard.

The food itself was excellent, but I hope the restaurant will pay more attention to food-handling and hygiene practices. These small details can make a big difference to the overall dining experience.

Dear Mr/.Ms. KT,

My name is Minh Ta – Restaurant Manager at Pizza 4P’s Vo Van Kiet. 
On behalf of our team, I sincerely apologize that your recent visit fell short of your expectations due to issues with our service hygiene and restroom cleanliness. We truly appreciate you choosing Pizza 4P’s and taking the time to share your honest feedback with us.

While we are delighted to hear that you enjoyed our food, we take your hygiene concerns very seriously. We have immediately retrained our service partner to maintain a safe distance when presenting dishes to prevent any health concerns. Additionally, as the restroom facilities are shared with the building, we are actively working with the building management to ensure they are strictly maintained and kept in the best possible condition at all times.

Thank you for helping us improve our standards. We hope to have another opportunity to welcome you back and provide you with a much better experience in the future. Wishing you a wonderful day ahead!

Sincerely,
Minh Ta – Restaurant Manager, Pizza 4P’s Vo Van Kiet

We visited here, having heard lots of good reports on the 4P's chain. It's a hard place to get a booking, so we ended up there quite late. Service was good, and the restaurant was nice, but the pizzas were just ok. The toppings were ok, but it just seemed like the pizzas weren't cooked properly. Having heard all the recommendations, we were quite disappointed, and we probably wouldn't return.

Dear Mr/Ms Craig M,

My name is Loi Vien, Restaurant Manager at Pizza 4P's Le Thanh Ton.
First of all, I would like to sincerely thank you for choosing Pizza 4P's Le Thanh Ton and for taking the time to share your feedback about your experience.

I am truly sorry to learn that the quality of the pizza during your recent visit did not meet your expectations, particularly regarding the pizza not being baked as expected. We will review and recheck our preparation process, as well as the baking time and temperature, to ensure consistent pizza quality.

At the same time, I am glad to know that you appreciated our service and the restaurant's atmosphere. However, we understand that these positive aspects could not make up for the disappointment you felt when the food did not provide the experience you had expected after hearing so many good recommendations about Pizza 4P's.

Once again, I sincerely apologize for the incomplete experience during your visit, and I truly appreciate your feedback, which gives us an opportunity to reflect and improve.

If you have any further questions or feedback, please contact us via 4P's Guest Service Assistance (09:00 - 22:00)
- Domestic Contact: 1900 6043
- International Contact: (+84) 2836220500
- Facebook Messenger: m.me/Pizza4Ps
- Email: feedback@pizza4ps.com.

Sincerely,
Loi Vien
Restaurant Manager

restaurant_name: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese Cuisine & Vegetarian Food
review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I had a wonderful experience at De Tham Restaurant, and I especially want to recognize my server, Anna. She was extremely polite, patient, attentive, and genuinely helpful throughout my meal.

What impressed me most was her initiative. I’m visiting Vietnam and still learning how some Vietnamese dishes are traditionally eaten. Anna didn’t just bring my food and walk away. She took the time to come over, help cut the pork for me, and explain how to eat it with the rice paper. When I thought I needed to dip the rice paper in water, she patiently explained that it was already soft and ready to use.

Those may seem like small things, but when you’re a visitor experiencing unfamiliar food, that kind of patience and hospitality makes a big difference. I never felt rushed or uncomfortable asking questions.

The food was delicious, but Anna’s service made the experience even better. She was warm, professional, patient, and attentive without being overbearing. Thank you, Anna, for making my meal such an enjoyable experience. I would gladly come back again. Highly recommended! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
